title: Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround
description:
Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, editing quality, and production speed



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a fast-growing U.S.-based live-commerce and e-commerce company specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We are actively expanding our presence on Instagram, YouTube, and other social media platforms.



We are looking for a highly experienced, extremely efficient video editor who specializes in creating professional, engaging, high-retention YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



We are NOT looking for a beginner. We need someone who already knows how to create excellent short-form content and can deliver high-quality edits quickly.



This is not strictly an editing position. We also need someone who can independently come up with creative, interesting, and potentially viral video ideas for our social media channels.



## What You'll Be Editing



Our content primarily consists of:



- Retro and modern video game videos

- Rare and expensive collectible showcases

- Interesting products and merchandise

- Behind-the-scenes business content

- Live auction and Whatnot highlights

- Product unboxings and demonstrations

- Educational and entertaining gaming content

- Viral-style Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts



Most videos will be approximately 15–90 seconds long.



We provide the original footage. Your responsibility is to transform that footage into engaging, polished, ready-to-post content.



You will also be responsible for recommending new video concepts that our team can film.



## Responsibilities



- Edit short-form videos specifically for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Create strong hooks within the first 1–3 seconds to capture attention.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, awkward moments, and dead space.

- Add clean, engaging, professionally animated subtitles.

- Incorporate appropriate zooms, transitions, motion graphics, and visual effects.

- Add sound effects and music when appropriate.

- Find and insert relevant B-roll, product images, screenshots, and other supporting visuals.

- Improve audio quality, lighting, exposure, and color consistency when necessary.

- Understand pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

- Make editing decisions that increase watch time and keep viewers engaged.

- Follow branding guidelines while maintaining a clean, professional appearance.

- Create content that feels natural and premium, not overly edited or artificial.

- Deliver finalized videos in 1080 × 1920 vertical format.

- Organize project files and provide revisions when necessary.

- Communicate clearly and consistently about assignments and deadlines.

- Independently research and suggest new video ideas for our channels.

- Recommend hooks, video structures, filming techniques, and content angles that could improve performance.



## Video Ideas & Content Development



In addition to editing, you must be capable of consistently generating creative video ideas.



We do not want an editor who simply waits for footage and instructions every day.



We want someone who actively contributes to the growth of our social media presence by researching trends, studying successful content, and suggesting new videos for our team to create.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Regularly researching successful Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form content.

- Identifying trending video concepts that could be adapted to our gaming, collectibles, and e-commerce content.

- Developing original, interesting, and attention-grabbing video ideas.

- Providing clear concepts that explain what we should film and why viewers would find the video interesting.

- Suggesting strong opening hooks and titles for each idea.

- Recommending specific camera angles, shots, or footage needed to execute the idea.

- Identifying opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content.

- Studying competitors and successful creators to identify content opportunities.

- Recommending improvements to our existing videos based on performance and viewer engagement.

- Helping us establish a consistent pipeline of new content ideas.



We expect you to proactively contribute ideas on a regular basis rather than needing to be asked.



For example, if you notice a particular style of retro gaming video performing well on social media, you should be able to suggest how Skylar Racing could create its own original version.



Ideally, you should provide a brief description, suggested hook, filming requirements, and an explanation of why the concept could perform well.



The ability to generate strong video concepts is a requirement for this position, not an optional bonus.



## Speed Is Extremely Important



We are specifically looking for an editor who can work FAST without sacrificing quality.



Our goal is to publish content consistently, and we need someone who can keep up with a high-volume editing workflow.



You should be capable of:



- Completing straightforward short-form edits within 24 hours of receiving footage and instructions.

- Editing multiple videos per working day when footage and editing complexity allow.

- Working on multiple projects without losing organization or quality.

- Prioritizing urgent assignments and meeting agreed deadlines.

- Making requested revisions efficiently.

- Working independently without constant instructions or supervision.



We are not interested in waiting several days for a basic 30–60-second Reel.



Please be realistic about your editing speed. We will evaluate both the quality of your work and how efficiently you complete assignments.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional video editing experience, or an equivalent portfolio demonstrating advanced skills.

- Extensive experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable professional editing software.

- Strong understanding of viral short-form content, viewer retention, and social media trends.

- Excellent caption animation and motion graphics skills.

- Ability to create visually appealing videos without excessive effects or unnecessary distractions.

- Strong storytelling skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to independently develop and pitch creative video concepts.

- Ability to research content trends and identify opportunities for original videos.

- Strong understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling and watch a video.

- Ability to find and incorporate relevant supporting images and B-roll.

- Excellent understanding of music, sound effects, audio mixing, and timing.

- Ability to work quickly while maintaining consistently high standards.

- Reliable internet access and a computer capable of handling professional editing workloads.

- Strong English comprehension and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions precisely.



## Preferred Skills



- Experience editing gaming, technology, collectibles, or e-commerce content.

- Experience creating viral videos with significant organic views.

- Experience developing short-form content strategies and video concepts.

- Ability to analyze why certain videos perform better than others.

- Advanced masking, tracking, and motion graphics experience.

- Experience creating Instagram Reel and YouTube Shorts thumbnails.

- Understanding of YouTube and Instagram content formatting and safe zones.

- Ability to recommend better hooks, pacing, and video structure.

- Familiarity with trends without relying on repetitive editing templates.



## Editing Style We're Looking For



We want high-quality, engaging content that looks professionally edited.



Our preferred style includes:



- Fast-paced editing when appropriate

- Attention-grabbing opening hooks

- Clean, readable subtitles

- Smooth transitions and natural visual movement

- Relevant product close-ups and B-roll

- High-quality audio and sound design

- Strong storytelling and intentional pacing

- Natural-looking colors and realistic visuals

- Professional presentation without excessive effects



We do NOT want overly flashy, chaotic, cartoonish, or obviously AI-generated-looking videos.



Every effect should serve a purpose. We value strong editing decisions over unnecessary visual clutter.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful editor will consistently:



- Deliver content on time.

- Produce professional videos with minimal revisions.

- Understand the intended style without needing repeated explanations.

- Identify and remove boring or unnecessary footage.

- Make thoughtful decisions about hooks and storytelling.

- Maintain consistent quality across multiple videos.

- Proactively supply creative and actionable video ideas.

- Research trends and identify potential content opportunities.

- Suggest improvements based on actual video performance.

- Help us increase our output of high-quality short-form content.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio



Provide links to at least 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited. We strongly prefer YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels rather than traditional long-form videos.



2. Experience



How many years have you been professionally editing videos? Which editing programs do you use most frequently?



3. Editing Speed



Approximately how long does it take you to complete a polished 30–60-second Instagram Reel when provided with raw talking-head footage?



4. Daily Production Capacity



How many professional-quality Shorts or Reels could you realistically complete during an 8-hour working day?



5. Previous Results



Have any videos you edited achieved 100,000, 500,000, or 1,000,000+ views? If so, provide examples and explain your specific role in editing them.



6. Video Ideas & Creativity



In addition to editing, you will be expected to regularly come up with new video ideas. Describe your experience developing content concepts, researching trends, and suggesting videos for social media channels.



7. Creative Test



Provide 3 original YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels ideas that you believe would perform well for a company that sells retro video games, modern gaming products, and rare collectibles.



For each idea, briefly explain the concept, the opening hook, and what footage we would need to film.



8. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work, or your hourly/project rate for part-time work?



9. Availability



What hours are you typically available to work, and how soon could you begin?



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short, paid editing test using footage provided by our company.



The purpose is to evaluate:



- Editing quality

- Creative decisions

- Hook development

- Caption quality

- Sound design

- Attention to detail

- Turnaround time

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to generate original and engaging video ideas



Applicants who demonstrate exceptional editing quality, speed, and creativity will receive priority consideration.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR EDITOR" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, talented, and creative editor interested in developing a long-term working relationship with our company.

title: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher
description:
Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Researcher  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, research abilities, and performance



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a U.S.-based live-commerce business specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, consoles, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We sell a large volume of products through live auctions on Whatnot and are constantly looking for new inventory to purchase and resell.



We are looking for an extremely internet-savvy, knowledgeable, and motivated individual who can research products, discover profitable inventory opportunities, and provide purchasing recommendations to our team on a daily basis.



This position is primarily focused on video games and gaming-related merchandise, but we are also interested in products that would appeal to gamers, collectors, and our live auction audience.



You must already have a strong understanding of video games, gaming consoles, accessories, gaming collectibles, and online shopping marketplaces.



We are NOT looking for someone who needs to learn what a Nintendo DS, PlayStation Vita, GameCube, or Game Boy Advance is.



We want someone who genuinely understands the gaming industry, enjoys researching products online, and knows how to find interesting merchandise at competitive prices.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to search the internet every working day for products and inventory opportunities that Skylar Racing could purchase and resell through live auctions.



You will spend a significant portion of your day researching websites, comparing prices, identifying suppliers, and sending direct purchasing links to our team.



Responsibilities include:



- Search eBay daily for video game lots, consoles, handhelds, accessories, collectibles, and profitable inventory.

- Research liquidation websites for gaming-related inventory, overstock products, customer returns, and closeout merchandise.

- Search Alibaba for manufacturers, wholesalers, and products suitable for resale.

- Identify gaming accessories and products that could be purchased in bulk and sold individually.

- Discover interesting, unusual, or trending products that would appeal to gamers.

- Compare purchasing prices against realistic resale values.

- Research recent eBay sold listings and other relevant market data.

- Identify bulk deals, undervalued listings, and potential wholesale opportunities.

- Find suppliers offering large quantities of identical products at attractive prices.

- Research international and domestic sourcing opportunities.

- Identify products that could work particularly well in a fast-paced live auction environment.

- Send direct links to potential inventory purchases to our team every working day.

- Maintain an organized daily list of sourcing opportunities in Google Sheets.

- Monitor previously discovered products for price changes, restocks, and new availability.

- Immediately communicate particularly valuable or time-sensitive purchasing opportunities.

- Continuously discover new websites and suppliers rather than relying on the same few sources.



You will not be responsible for purchasing inventory without authorization. Your role is to research opportunities and provide accurate, organized recommendations.



## Daily Product Links & Purchasing Recommendations



This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.



We expect you to actively search for new inventory opportunities and send links to products that our company could realistically purchase every single scheduled working day.



You should not wait for management to ask you to find products.



Your daily responsibilities will include:



- Continuously searching eBay, Alibaba, liquidation websites, wholesalers, and other marketplaces.

- Sending links to potential purchases throughout your working shift.

- Providing accurate purchase prices, quantities, condition details, and relevant information.

- Explaining why you believe each product is worth considering.

- Identifying opportunities where the purchase price is significantly below realistic resale value.

- Finding products that can be purchased in bulk at attractive prices.

- Locating merchandise that would appeal to our existing gaming and collector audience.

- Keeping an organized list of all potential purchases.

- Ensuring links are active and products are still available when submitted.

- Avoiding duplicate recommendations unless pricing or availability has materially changed.

- Providing a daily summary of the strongest purchasing opportunities discovered.



We expect a consistent flow of new purchasing opportunities.



Our initial target is approximately 10–20 qualified product leads per full working day, depending on the complexity of the research. Quality is more important than volume, and this target may be adjusted as we evaluate the usefulness of your recommendations.



We are not looking for someone who sends random eBay listings or overpriced retail products just to meet a daily quota.



Every submitted link should represent a genuine potential purchasing opportunity supported by research.



If you discover an unusually good deal that could sell out quickly, we expect you to communicate that opportunity immediately rather than waiting until the end of your shift.



At the end of each working day, our purchasing team should have a clear list of new products, suppliers, and potential purchases to review.



Consistently providing useful purchasing links is a core performance expectation for this role.



## Gaming Knowledge Is Required



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands video games and gaming-related merchandise.



You should be familiar with:



- Nintendo handhelds, including Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 3DS, and related models.

- Sony consoles and handhelds, including PlayStation, PSP, PS Vita, and related accessories.

- Nintendo consoles such as Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, Nintendo Switch, and newer systems.

- Xbox consoles, controllers, and accessories.

- Retro and modern video game cartridges and discs.

- Console controllers, replacement accessories, adapters, cables, and peripherals.

- Special edition gaming consoles and collectible merchandise.

- Japanese video games, imported consoles, and gaming accessories.

- Console repair tools, replacement parts, and maintenance accessories.

- Gaming-related electronics, gadgets, and collectibles.



You do not need to know the value of every item, but you should have enough gaming knowledge to recognize interesting products, identify potential deals, and research unfamiliar items efficiently.



A strong understanding of Japanese gaming products and retro gaming is particularly valuable.



## Products We Want You to Find



Although gaming is our primary focus, we sell many different types of merchandise.



We are interested in sourcing:



- Retro video games, consoles, and handhelds

- Modern gaming consoles and accessories

- Gaming controllers and replacement parts

- Gaming repair tools and electronics accessories

- Gaming collectibles, figures, and novelty products

- Gaming-themed merchandise and desk accessories

- Gaming room decorations and display products

- Interesting technology products and gadgets

- Unique electronics and useful everyday accessories

- Bulk liquidation and closeout products

- Products that can be purchased cheaply in large quantities

- Unique merchandise that gamers and collectors would be excited to purchase



For example, finding a manufacturer offering an interesting gaming accessory for $2 per unit could be valuable if the product has realistic resale demand and attractive margins.



Finding a bulk lot of retro video games on eBay at a significantly lower price than their realistic resale value could also be valuable.



We are especially interested in unique products, good deals, large quantities, and merchandise that would create excitement during our live auctions.



## Websites & Marketplaces



You should already be comfortable navigating online marketplaces and conducting extensive internet research.



Websites you may regularly use include:



- eBay

- Alibaba

- AliExpress

- Major liquidation and closeout websites

- Wholesale inventory marketplaces

- Manufacturer and distributor websites

- Japanese gaming marketplaces

- International wholesale suppliers

- Specialty retro gaming websites

- Online auction websites

- Other product sourcing and wholesale platforms



You should be able to discover additional sourcing websites independently.



We do not want someone who only knows how to perform basic Google searches.



We want someone who knows how to use search filters, advanced search terms, sold listing history, image searches, marketplace categories, and other research tools to uncover opportunities that may not be immediately obvious.



## Understanding Live Auction Sales



Our company sells merchandise through live auctions, primarily on Whatnot.



Understanding this business model is extremely important.



The products we purchase are not necessarily the same products that traditional online retailers would prioritize.



You should understand that:



- Some products sell quickly because they are recognizable and desirable.

- Interesting products can perform well even if they are inexpensive.

- Bulk quantities can be more valuable to us than a single profitable item.

- A product's perceived value and actual demand both matter.

- Live auction prices may differ significantly from traditional eBay listing prices.

- Purchasing cost, shipping, platform fees, defects, and other expenses affect profitability.

- The ability to repeatedly source a successful product can be extremely valuable.



Experience buying or selling on Whatnot is highly preferred.



At a minimum, you should familiarize yourself with how Whatnot live auctions operate, including how streamers present products and how customers bid.



## Product Research & Profitability



We expect you to evaluate potential purchasing opportunities rather than simply forwarding links.



When recommending a product, you should be able to provide:



1. Product name and description.

2. Direct link to the listing or supplier.

3. Purchase price and currency.

4. Available quantity or minimum order quantity.

5. Estimated shipping costs when available.

6. Relevant product condition information.

7. Recent comparable sold prices or other supporting market data.

8. Estimated resale price or realistic resale range.

9. Potential profitability, accounting for known expenses.

10. A short explanation of why the product could sell well during our live auctions.



You are not expected to know every expense perfectly, but you should identify uncertainties and avoid presenting unsupported resale estimates as guaranteed profits.



We value accurate research far more than exaggerated profit projections.



## Alibaba & Wholesale Sourcing



Alibaba sourcing will also be an important part of this position.



You should be comfortable:



- Searching Alibaba for gaming accessories and unique products.

- Comparing multiple manufacturers offering similar products.

- Identifying suppliers with competitive pricing.

- Reviewing minimum order quantities.

- Understanding basic product customization and private-label opportunities.

- Comparing product quality, specifications, and supplier information.

- Identifying inexpensive products with strong potential resale demand.

- Researching products that could complement our existing merchandise.

- Finding accessories that we could eventually sell under our own brand.

- Understanding that sample costs, international shipping, duties, and product quality affect overall cost.



Previous experience with Alibaba or international product sourcing is highly preferred.



You must also be able to recognize potential counterfeit, trademark, copyright, safety, or compliance concerns and flag those products rather than recommending them for purchase without further review.



## Internet Research Skills



This position requires excellent internet research skills.



You should be capable of navigating websites quickly, opening and comparing multiple listings, using advanced search filters, and organizing large amounts of product information.



You should know how to:



- Search efficiently across many websites.

- Use advanced keywords and search operators.

- Find alternative suppliers for a specific product.

- Use Google Lens or reverse image searches to identify products.

- Compare listings for the same or similar merchandise.

- Identify suspicious or unreliable sellers.

- Find historical sold prices rather than relying solely on asking prices.

- Research products using Japanese or other international websites when necessary.

- Use translation tools to navigate foreign-language listings.

- Identify listings that are duplicates or no longer available.

- Organize research efficiently using Google Sheets.



We are looking for someone who is genuinely skilled at navigating the internet and discovering information independently.



## Speed, Productivity & Organization



Efficiency is extremely important.



We need someone who can research products quickly, identify worthwhile opportunities, and avoid spending excessive amounts of time on unpromising listings.



You should be able to:



- Work efficiently across multiple browser tabs and websites.

- Research multiple product categories during a working day.

- Send new potential purchasing links consistently throughout each shift.

- Maintain an organized record of potential purchases.

- Prioritize opportunities based on estimated profitability and availability.

- Immediately communicate unusually strong or time-sensitive deals.

- Avoid repeatedly submitting the same listings.

- Distinguish high-quality opportunities from ordinary retail listings.

- Consistently produce useful research without needing constant supervision.



Our priority is quality purchasing opportunities, not simply the number of links submitted.



Submitting 10 excellent opportunities is more valuable than submitting 100 random products that would not be profitable.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong existing knowledge of retro and modern video games.

- Excellent internet research and online marketplace navigation skills.

- Familiarity with eBay and online shopping platforms.

- Ability to identify gaming products, accessories, and collectibles.

- Understanding of product pricing and resale value research.

- Familiarity with wholesale and liquidation sourcing.

- Ability to compare listings and identify attractive purchasing opportunities.

- Ability to consistently research and submit potential purchasing links every working day.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent organizational skills.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet daily expectations.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Willingness to learn new sourcing websites and research methods.

- Ability to accurately document product links, pricing, quantities, and other relevant information.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using Whatnot as a buyer or seller.

- Previous experience sourcing products for e-commerce or resale businesses.

- Experience purchasing or researching video game lots on eBay.

- Experience sourcing products through Alibaba.

- Familiarity with Japanese gaming marketplaces.

- Knowledge of gaming merchandise resale values.

- Experience with liquidation or wholesale product sourcing.

- Understanding of profit margins and inventory purchasing.

- Experience finding clearance, closeout, or bulk inventory deals.

- Familiarity with Google Lens, reverse image searches, and advanced online research.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful employee will:



- Send a consistent stream of qualified purchasing links every scheduled working day.

- Consistently discover products we would realistically consider purchasing.

- Find inventory at prices that allow for attractive resale margins.

- Identify gaming products and accessories with strong customer appeal.

- Discover suppliers or products our team has not previously considered.

- Provide accurate and well-organized research.

- Find useful wholesale and bulk purchasing opportunities.

- Quickly communicate worthwhile deals before they disappear.

- Develop a strong understanding of the types of products that perform well in our live auctions.

- Improve the quality of their purchasing recommendations over time.

- Produce daily sourcing reports that give management actionable opportunities to review.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative and genuinely enjoys the process of hunting for profitable products online.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. Gaming Knowledge



How familiar are you with retro and modern video games? Which gaming consoles, handhelds, accessories, and collectibles do you have the most knowledge about? Please be specific.



2. Previous Sourcing Experience



Have you previously sourced products for resale, researched wholesale inventory, or found deals on eBay, Alibaba, or liquidation websites? Explain your experience and which websites you have used.



3. Internet Research Skills



Describe your process for finding an underpriced product online. Which websites, search tools, browser extensions, or research methods would you use to determine whether it is a good deal?



4. Live Selling Knowledge



Are you familiar with Whatnot or other live auction platforms? Have you purchased or sold anything through live auctions? What do you think makes a product successful in this selling environment?



5. Alibaba Experience



Have you used Alibaba to research manufacturers or wholesale products? If so, describe your experience comparing suppliers, pricing, minimum order quantities, and product specifications.



6. Daily Research Productivity



This position requires sending potential purchasing links to our team every working day. How would you organize your daily research to consistently discover worthwhile opportunities? Approximately how many properly researched product recommendations do you believe you could provide during an 8-hour shift?



7. Practical Research Question



Imagine we want to purchase 100 inexpensive gaming-related accessories that could be sold individually during live auctions.



Where would you look for these products, how would you evaluate them, and what information would you provide before recommending a purchase?



8. Work Availability



What is your daily availability, Monday through Sunday? Are you looking for full-time or part-time employment, and how soon could you begin?



9. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in PHP for full-time employment, or your hourly rate for part-time employment?



## Application Test



To demonstrate your research ability, include 3 actual products you discovered online that you believe could be profitable for our business.



At least 2 products should be gaming-related.



For each product, include:



- Product name

- Direct purchasing link

- Current purchase price

- Available quantity, if shown

- Estimated resale price and supporting evidence

- Brief explanation of why you believe it would be a good product for our live auctions



Please do not submit random popular products without considering their potential profitability.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete an additional paid research assignment.



## Selection Process



We will evaluate applicants based on:



- Gaming knowledge

- Familiarity with online marketplaces

- Research speed and efficiency

- Quality of product sourcing recommendations

- Ability to consistently provide useful daily purchasing links

- Understanding of resale value and profitability

- Ability to identify unique inventory opportunities

- Organizational and communication skills

- Independent problem-solving ability



Previous sourcing experience is valuable, but exceptional gaming knowledge and outstanding internet research skills are equally important.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read the full job description, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR SOURCING" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, knowledgeable, and highly motivated individual interested in building a long-term working relationship with Skylar Racing.

title: Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead
description:
We have ambitious plans to grow rapidly. Our entire ecosystem has been divided into 4 new positions. We are looking for people who have the knowledge and experience to join our team and take our 23 year old company to the next level.



Feel free to browse our 4 open positions, but do not apply to any if you do not have the experience required. Thanks you.



Here they are:



1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead

2. Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Performance Specialist

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



This ad is for position #1 

1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead



SENIOR TECHNICAL & ECOMMERCE SEO LEAD

Full-Time Permanent Position — 40 Hours Per Week

Job Overview



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead to take ownership of the organic-search performance of our ecommerce website.



This is not a temporary SEO project.



This is not a position for someone whose SEO experience consists primarily of WordPress plugins, writing blog posts, buying backlinks, or running automated audits.



Our website is a custom-built ecommerce platform using PHP, HTML5 and CSS. We need someone who understands how search engines crawl, index, interpret and rank ecommerce websites and who can work directly with our website and development team to correct problems and build long-term organic growth.



Our primary objective is not simply more traffic.

Our objective is more qualified search traffic, more orders and more revenue.



You will be the primary owner of the website's technical SEO, ecommerce SEO, on-page SEO, keyword strategy, site architecture, content SEO strategy, local SEO and organic-search measurement.



You will work closely with a separate Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Specialist.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Complete Technical SEO Ownership



Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits and personally identify, prioritize and resolve issues affecting crawling, indexing, rankings and website performance.



You must understand and be able to work with:



Google crawling and indexing

Google Search Console

3XX and 4XX errors

Broken internal links

Broken external links

Redirect chains

Redirect loops

301 redirects

Canonical tags

Duplicate URLs

Duplicate content

Duplicate title tags

Duplicate meta descriptions

Missing titles and descriptions

Index/noindex directives

robots.txt

XML sitemaps

Orphan pages

Crawl depth

URL parameters

Search/filter URLs

Pagination

Faceted navigation

JavaScript rendering issues

Mobile SEO

Page speed

Core Web Vitals

Image optimization

Structured data

Crawl-budget considerations on large sites



You must be able to explain WHY a technical issue exists and determine the correct solution rather than simply reporting what an automated SEO tool flags.



2. URL CLEANUP, DUPLICATE PAGES & SITE MIGRATIONS



Our website has historical URLs, duplicate products/pages, an older website and other URLs that may need to be preserved, consolidated, redirected, canonicalized, noindexed or removed.



You must know how to d
:



Which URL should remain

Which version should be canonical

Which URL should receive a 301 redirect

Which URL should be removed

Which page should be noindexed

When similar pages should remain separate

How to preserve valuable backlinks and historical authority

How to retire an old site or subdomain correctly

How to migrate content without unnecessarily losing rankings

How to update internal links after migrations

How to monitor Google after major changes



We do not want someone making mass URL changes without understanding the consequences.



3. ECOMMERCE SEO



You will develop and maintain the SEO architecture for an ecommerce website with hundreds of products and the potential for thousands of products, categories, templates, landing pages and supporting content pages.



You will optimize:



Product pages

Product categories

Subcategories

Landing pages

Product variants

Design/template pages

Supporting informational content



You must understand how an ecommerce website should be structured so search engines can determine which pages are most important.



4. PRODUCT PAGE SEO



You will establish and implement standards for every important product page.



This includes:



Keyword targeting

Search intent

Product titles

Meta titles

Meta descriptions

H1/H2 structure

Product descriptions

Supporting copy

FAQs

Images

Image filenames where appropriate

Alt text

Internal links

Related products

Breadcrumbs

Calls to action

Structured data

Product variants

Offers

Shipping/return information where applicable

Conversion-focused content



Every important page should have a clear purpose and search opportunity.



5. CATEGORY & SITE ARCHITECTURE SEO



Build a logical hierarchy such as:

Home ? Major Category ? Subcategory ? Product



and:

Blog/Guide ? Category ? Product



You will determine when we need:



New categories

New subcategories

New landing pages

Consolidated categories

Better navigation

Improved breadcrumbs

Better internal-link relationships



You will identify orphan pages and pages receiving insufficient internal authority.



6. KEYWORD RESEARCH & KEYWORD MAPPING



Perform ongoing keyword research based on actual customer searches and buying intent.



Research should include:



Transactional keywords

Commercial keywords

Informational keywords

Product keywords

Category keywords

Long-tail keywords

Non-branded keywords

Branded keywords

Competitor keywords

Local keywords

Search volume

Keyword difficulty

SERP competition

Search intent



Maintain a keyword-to-URL map showing which page is intended to rank for each important keyword/topic.



Prevent unnecessary keyword cannibalization where several pages compete for the same intent.



7. ON-PAGE SEO



Personally manage or direct:



Titles

Meta descriptions

H1/H2/H3 structure

URLs

Content

Product descriptions

Category content

Alt text

Internal anchor text

Internal links

Breadcrumbs

Related products

FAQs

Page relevance

Calls to action



We expect optimization for human customers and search engines.



Keyword stuffing is not acceptable.



8. STRUCTURED DATA / SCHEMA



Understand and correctly implement or specify structured data including appropriate types such as:



Product

Product variants

Offer

Breadcrumb

Organization

LocalBusiness

Article

Video

Shipping information

Return policies

Other appropriate ecommerce structured data



You must know how to test structured data and troubleshoot errors.



9. GOOGLE MERCHANT CENTER



Experience with Google Merchant Center is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities may include:



Product feed setup

Feed diagnostics

Product eligibility

Pricing accuracy

Availability

Product identifiers

Images

Free product listings

Feed/website consistency

Merchant Center errors and warnings



Work with our Paid Search Specialist when product-feed information is also being used for Shopping campaigns.



10. CONTENT SEO STRATEGY



You are responsible for determining WHAT SEO content we need and WHY.



Potential content includes:



Buying guides

Printing guides

Design guides

How-to content

FAQs

Comparison pages

Industry pages

Product-use ideas

Customer education

Videos/supporting video pages

Location/service pages where legitimate

Evergreen resources



You do not necessarily have to personally write every article.



You must be able to create detailed content briefs specifying:



Target search intent

Primary keyword/theme

Supporting topics

Questions to answer

Recommended page structure

Internal links

Products/categories being supported

Conversion goal

11. COMPETITOR SEO ANALYSIS



Continuously monitor major competitors.



Analyze:



Keywords

Ranking pages

Category structures

Product pages

Content

Internal linking

SERP visibility

Structured data

Backlink profiles

Content gaps

Product gaps

Search features

Competitor strengths

Competitor weaknesses



You will share backlink opportunities with our Off-Page SEO Specialist.



We do not blindly copy competitors.



We determine what works and build something better.



12. LOCAL SEO



Own the organic portion of our local-search strategy.



Responsibilities include:



Google Business Profile optimization

Business categories

Products/services

Business information

NAP consistency

Local citations strategy

Local keyword research

Legitimate location/service pages

Local competitor analysis

Google Maps/local-pack visibility

Reviews/reputation SEO strategy

Local organic reporting

13. GOOGLE SEARCH CONSOLE



You should be highly proficient with Search Console.



Use it regularly for:



Queries

Landing pages

Impressions

Clicks

CTR

Rankings

Indexing

URL Inspection

Sitemaps

Core Web Vitals

Structured-data issues

Manual actions

Security issues

Identifying content opportunities



Search Console should be a working tool, not something checked once a month.



14. GOOGLE ANALYTICS 4 & SEO MEASUREMENT



Work with GA4 to understand:



Organic users

Organic sessions

Landing pages

Engagement

Ecommerce events

Add-to-cart

Checkout

Purchases

Revenue

Conversion rates

New vs. returning visitors



SEO must be tied to business results.



15. GOOGLE TAG MANAGER / TRACKING KNOWLEDGE



You must understand tracking well enough to work with GTM and developers on:



GA4

Ecommerce tracking

Product views

Add-to-cart

Begin checkout

Purchases

Revenue

Forms

Phone-call tracking where appropriate

Other conversion events



Our separate paid-media specialists will use this measurement infrastructure.



16. CONVERSION RATE OPTIMIZATION



Organic SEO traffic is worthless if it does not convert.



Evaluate:



Landing-page experience

Product-page usability

Calls to action

Navigation

Mobile experience

Trust signals

Reviews

Forms

Checkout friction

Product information

Page layout

Search intent alignment



Recommend and test improvements.



17. TOOLS



You should have extensive hands-on experience with several of the following:



Google Search Console

GA4

Google Tag Manager

Google Business Profile

Google Merchant Center

Screaming Frog

Ahrefs

Semrush

PageSpeed Insights

Lighthouse

Rich Results Test

Schema validators

Looker Studio

Bing Webmaster Tools

Microsoft Clarity



We care about what you can accomplish with these tools, not how many names you can put on a resume.



TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE



Our website is custom built using PHP, HTML5 and CSS.



You do not need to be our primary programmer, but you must understand enough to work intelligently with:



HTML

CSS

PHP concepts

JavaScript SEO

HTTP status codes

HTTP headers

Canonicals

Redirects

robots.txt

XML

JSON-LD

Schema

DNS/domain concepts

Server behavior



You must be comfortable communicating exact technical requirements to developers.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will have final SEO ownership over:



Technical SEO

Ecommerce SEO

Site architecture

Indexation

URL decisions

On-page SEO

Keyword strategy

Internal linking

Schema

Content SEO strategy

Merchant Center organic/product-data coordination

Local organic SEO

Search Console

Organic reporting

Organic CRO recommendations

FIRST 90 DAYS

Phase 1 — Audit & Measurement

Crawl entire website

Verify Search Console

Verify GA4

Verify GTM

Verify ecommerce tracking

Establish indexation baseline

Establish ranking baseline

Audit URLs

Audit old websites/subdomains

Audit site architecture

Audit schema

Audit product/category SEO

Audit page speed

Audit local SEO

Audit competitors

Build prioritized roadmap

Phase 2 — Critical Cleanup



Correct:



Indexation problems

Duplicate URLs

Duplicate content

Broken links

Redirects

Canonicals

Metadata

Sitemaps

robots directives

Internal links

Mobile problems

Schema

Major performance issues

Phase 3 — Growth Foundation



Build:



Keyword map

Site architecture plan

Product SEO standards

Category SEO standards

Internal-linking strategy

Content roadmap

Local SEO roadmap

Reporting dashboard

THIS IS A PERMANENT POSITION



Once the original technical cleanup is complete, your job does not end.



You will continuously:



Analyze ? Prioritize ? Implement ? Measure ? Improve ? Repeat



Every week there should be opportunities to improve rankings, pages, categories, products, content, conversions or technical performance.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



We prefer:



5+ years serious SEO experience

Strong technical SEO background

Ecommerce SEO experience

Experience with custom websites

Proven Search Console/GA4 expertise

Experience handling migrations and URL consolidation

Strong keyword and site-architecture skills

Understanding of modern Google Search practices



Years alone will not get you hired.



You must demonstrate that you know what you are doing.



TO APPLY



Please provide:



PDF resume.

Three ecommerce websites you personally worked on.

Explain specifically what YOU did on each.

Show before/after Search Console or organic performance where possible.

Give an example of a serious technical SEO problem you personally diagnosed and fixed.



Then answer:



Question 1



A website has 300 legitimate products, but Google and Screaming Frog discover thousands of URLs. What do you investigate first?



Question 2



We have several highly similar product URLs. Explain how you determine whether to keep them separate, canonicalize them, redirect them, noindex them or delete them.



Question 3



We have an old website with years of history and backlinks that needs to be retired. Explain exactly how you would handle the migration.



Question 4



Explain crawling, indexing, canonicalization, noindex and a 301 redirect in your own words.



Question 5



What would you be working on every week six months after the major technical problems were fixed?



Question 6



Review 72 HR 
 and give us three specific SEO issues or opportunities you see.



Generic AI-style applications will not move forward.



We want someone who can investigate, explain, implement and take ownership.

title: Social Media Graphic Designer / Video Creator
description:
Full-Time Social Media Graphic Designer / Video Creator for Apparel Manufacturing Company

40 Hours Per Week | Paid Christmas Break



We are a 23-year-old, multi-million-dollar apparel manufacturing company looking for a highly creative, highly skilled Social Media Graphic Designer and Video Content Creator to join our team full time.



This is not a basic design position. We are looking for someone with mad creative skills who understands how to create social media content that stops people from scrolling, grabs attention fast, and turns browsers into buyers.



Our company specializes in three main product categories:



Custom Dye Sublimation Apparel

Yard Signs

Banners



We want these products showcased across every major social media platform with powerful graphics, videos, ads, images, carousels, reels, and other high-converting creative content.



About the Position



We are hiring a full-time creative professional who can produce eye-catching social media content for platforms including:



TikTok

Instagram


YouTube Shorts

Pinterest

LinkedIn

Paid social media ads

Website and promotional campaigns



You will be responsible for creating content that makes people stop, look, click, message, and buy.



The ideal person understands branding, design, advertising, video editing, AI tools, social media trends, and what makes content perform online. You should be able to take a product, idea, promotion, or campaign and turn it into attention-grabbing creative that looks professional, modern, and high-impact.



Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:

Creating social media graphics, videos, reels, image ads, carousel posts, story graphics, banners, and promotional content

Designing content for both organic social media and paid advertising campaigns

Creating high-converting visuals that showcase our custom dye sublimation apparel, yard signs, and banners

Producing scroll-stopping graphics that are built to generate engagement, leads, and sales

Editing short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts

Designing product-focused ads that clearly communicate value and drive action

Creating carousel posts that educate, promote, and sell

Developing creative concepts for promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and special offers

Using Adobe Creative Cloud software to create professional-quality designs and videos

Using AI tools such as ChatGPT and other creative AI solutions to improve speed, creativity, copy, concepts, and output

Staying up to date with social media trends, viral content styles, platform changes, and advertising best practices

Working with our team to turn product ideas and marketing goals into polished creative assets

Creating multiple versions of ads and posts for testing different hooks, headlines, layouts, and calls to action

Helping build a strong, recognizable brand presence across all social platforms

Required Skills and Experience



The right candidate must have strong experience with:

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe Illustrator

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe Creative Cloud

Social media graphic design

Short-form video editing

Paid ad creative

Carousel design

Product-focused marketing content

Branding and visual storytelling

Typography, layout, color, and composition

Creating content for TikTok, Instagram,
, and other social media platforms

Designing content that is not only beautiful, but also built to sell



You must understand how to create graphics and videos that immediately capture attention. Pretty designs are not enough. We need content that performs.



AI and Technology Skills



We are looking for someone who knows how to combine real creative skill with modern AI tools.



Experience with tools like the following is a major plus:



ChatGPT

AI image generation tools

AI video tools

AI copywriting tools

AI design assistants

Canva AI or Adobe Firefly

Other AI tools that help create better, faster, more effective content



You should know how to use both your own design skills and AI technology to create powerful, polished, award-worthy graphics and videos.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



Extremely creative

Experienced and confident

Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented

Skilled at turning ideas into professional designs

Able to create content that looks modern, clean, bold, and exciting

Passionate about social media and visual marketing

Comfortable working on multiple projects and campaigns

Strong at taking feedback and improving creative quickly

Able to think like a marketer, not just a designer

Focused on creating content that gets attention and helps generate sales



This position is perfect for someone who loves creating powerful social media content and wants to be part of a growing, established company with real products, real customers, and a big opportunity to make an impact.



Schedule and Benefits



This is a guaranteed full-time position.



40 hours per week

Long-term opportunity with an established company

Paid Christmas Break every year

Work with a 23-year-old multi-million-dollar apparel manufacturing company

Opportunity to create high-impact content for real products and real campaigns

Opportunity to help grow a strong social media presence across multiple platforms

Our Products



You will be helping promote and showcase:



Custom Dye Sublimation Apparel

Bold, colorful, custom apparel made for teams, businesses, schools, events, brands, and organizations.



Yard Signs

High-visibility signs for events, promotions, businesses, campaigns, schools, and more.



Banners

Custom banners designed to help businesses, organizations, and events get noticed.



Your job will be to make these products look exciting, professional, and irresistible online.



Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate has a strong portfolio showing social media graphics, videos, ads, and creative campaigns. We want to see work that proves you can create content that catches attention quickly and makes people want to take action.



You should be able to show examples of:



Social media ads

Reels or TikTok-style videos

Instagram and
 graphics

Carousel posts

Product promotions

Branding work

Marketing graphics

Video editing projects

How to Apply



Please submit your resume, portfolio, and examples of your best social media graphics, videos, ads, and carousel designs.



We are especially interested in seeing work that proves you can create content that stops people from scrolling and turns browsers into buyers.



If you are a highly creative designer and video creator who knows Adobe, understands social media, uses AI tools, and wants a full-time opportunity with an established company, we want to hear from you.

title: Sublimation Apparel / Jersey Designer with years of experience
description:
Experienced Graphic Designers Wanted — Sublimation Apparel & Print Production



Please read this entire post before applying. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



We are looking to hire several highly talented, experienced Graphic Design Professionals to join our growing creative and production team. Most are local to you and hired off this site.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for elite designers with strong creative ability, excellent technical skills, and real-world experience in sublimation apparel, print production, and branded marketing materials.



Our company has been in the commercial printing industry for over 22 years and has grown into a full-service print and apparel operation, including:



Sign production

Vehicle wraps

Screen printing

Dye sublimation manufacturing

Cut-and-sew sublimated apparel

Commercial print and marketing materials



We are an international, multi-million-dollar operation producing high-quality printed products and premium sublimated apparel for clients around the world. Due to major growth in our Dye Sublimation Cut & Sew Division, we are expanding our team and looking for the best of the best.



Who We’re Looking For



We need experienced, multi-talented graphic designers who can handle more than basic t-shirt artwork. You must be a true creative professional who can confidently move between sublimated apparel, business cards, banners, flyers, brochures, signs, wraps, and other print assets without missing a beat.



You should be fast, accurate, highly creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a high-output production environment.



Required Skills & Experience



Applicants must have:

title: Experienced Life Insurance Appointment Setter | Outbound Calling & Aged Leads | U.S. Agency
description:
We're Looking for an Experienced Life Insurance Appointment Setter



Overflow Life & Legacy is a growing U.S.-based independent life insurance agency affiliated with Symmetry Financial Group.



We help individuals and families protect what matters most through mortgage protection and life insurance solutions.



We're looking for an experienced, results driven appointment setter who has worked specifically with U.S. life insurance leads and knows how to turn outbound conversations into qualified appointments.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION.



We're looking for someone who already understands the life insurance appointment-setting process, is confident on the phone, and knows how to follow up consistently without needing constant supervision.



If you've successfully booked appointments for U.S. life insurance agents, particularly using aged mortgage protection or final expense leads, we'd love to hear from you.

__________________





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your primary responsibility is to follow up with prospects who previously requested information about life insurance but haven't yet scheduled an appointment.



Many of these leads will be several weeks or months old, so you must be comfortable reconnecting with people who may not remember their initial inquiry.

__________________







YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE



- Making consistent outbound calls to assigned mortgage protection and life insurance leads.

- Reengaging older leads and starting natural, professional conversations.

- Following up with digital leads through phone calls and approved text messaging.

- Building rapport, handling initial objections, and helping interested prospects schedule appointments.

- Booking qualified appointments directly onto our agents' calendars.

- Confirming appointments and following up to improve attendance.

- Keeping accurate CRM notes, lead statuses, and follow-up reminders.

- Managing your assigned leads proactively so opportunities don't fall through the cracks.

- Tracking daily activity and reporting appointment-setting results.

- Following our approved scripts, contact procedures, and compliance guidelines.



You won't be responsible for selling insurance, quoting premiums, or recommending policies. Your focus is connecting with prospects and scheduling quality appointments with licensed agents.

__________________







REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS



**You must have previous experience setting appointments for U.S. life insurance agents.**



We're especially interested in candidates with:



- Proven outbound calling experience in the U.S. life insurance industry.

- Experience working aged insurance leads and following up over multiple contact attempts.

- Familiarity with mortgage protection, final expense, or similar life insurance leads.

- A track record of booking appointments that prospects actually attend.

- Strong spoken English and a confident, natural phone presence.

- Experience using CRMs, dialers, and SMS follow-up systems.

- Good judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.



Experience with Symmetry Financial Group, or other independent life insurance agencies is a strong plus.



You must also have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet working environment.

__________________







WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?



We're not looking for someone who just makes a high number of calls or fills a calendar with appointments.



We're looking for someone who:



- Knows how to start conversations without sounding robotic or overly scripted.

- Can reconnect with older leads without being pushy.

- Listens carefully and knows how to respond to hesitation or objections.

- Understands the importance of consistent, timely follow-up.

- Takes ownership of their assigned leads and works independently.

- Cares about the quality of appointments, not just the number booked.

- Is dependable, coachable, and committed to improving results.





**Our goal is simple: More meaningful conversations, more qualified appointments, and fewer missed opportunities.

__________________







SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- 15-20 hours per week initially.

- Work during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time calling hours, including some afternoon/evening availability.

- $4–$7 USD per hour, based on relevant experience and proven results.

- Opportunity for additional hours and long-term growth based on performance.

- Paid training on our agency's specific scripts, CRM, and processes.

- An established supply of leads and clear expectations.



We're building for the long term and want someone who can grow with our agency.

__________________





HOW TO APPLY



If you have experience setting appointments for U.S. life insurance agents, we'd love to hear from you!



To apply, please include:



1. Your Experience: Briefly describe your life insurance appointment-setting experience, including the types of leads you've worked with and any results you're proud of.

2. Voice or video Introduction: Include a short 60-second audio or video recording introducing yourself and sharing why you'd be a good fit for this role. *APPLICATIONS THAT DON'T INCLUDE THIS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

3. Availability: Let us know your availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Please begin your application with "Overflow Appointments" so we know you've read the posting. 





We look forward to hearing from you!



Overflow Life & Legacy

- Protect what matters. Build what lasts.

title: Cold Caller - Sell Websites to US Small Businesses ($2/hr + $25 per sale)
description:
We're Syra, a US company that builds websites for local businesses that don't have one: contractors, cleaners, barbers, auto shops and more.



Your job: call business owners in Texas, tell them we already built a free website for their business, text them the link, and help them sign up. No tech skills needed. We build the sites; you sell them.



PAY

- $2/hour base

- $25 for every paid sale (paid after a 7-day hold)



HOURS

- Full-time, 8am-5pm US Central time (12-1 break)



YOU NEED

- Clear, confident spoken English

- A quiet place to work, reliable internet and a laptop

- Confidence on the phone (US cold calling experience is a plus)

- Able to start right away



TO APPLY

Send a 1-minute voice recording of you pitching a website to a plumber who doesn't have one.

title: Senior Graphic Designer — Must Be Able to Design Almost Anything
description:
READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.

We are looking for an exceptional, highly experienced Graphic Designer who can handle almost any design project we put in front of them. This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are not looking for someone who only makes social media posts, logos, or basic T-shirt graphics.

We need a serious professional who can move from:

Dye Sublimation Apparel ? Vehicle Wraps ? T-Shirts ? Business Cards ? Brochures ? Signs ? Banners ? Marketing Materials ? Print Production

…and do all of it at a very high level.



If you are the kind of designer who can look at almost any project and say:

“Yes, I can design that.”

then we want to hear from you.



WHO WE ARE

We are an established international commercial printing and apparel company with more than 23 years in business.



Our capabilities include:

Dye sublimation printing

Cut-and-sew sublimated apparel

Screen printing

Custom T-shirts

Vehicle wraps

Signs

Banners

Large-format printing

Business cards

Flyers

Brochures

Marketing materials

Branding

Commercial printing



Our company is growing rapidly, especially our Dye Sublimation Cut & Sew Division, and we are extremely busy.

We need talented designers who can jump in and contribute immediately.



THIS POSITION IS FOR A REAL DESIGNER

You should be:

Extremely creative

Fast

Accurate

Detail-oriented

Technically strong

Production-minded

Able to work independently

Able to follow instructions

Able to handle revisions quickly

Comfortable with multiple deadlines

Capable of solving design problems without constant supervision

We need people who can think, create, execute, and deliver.



SOFTWARE SKILLS

You must be highly proficient with professional design software.

Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL REQUIRED - Illustrator is extremely important in our production environment.



You should be able to work quickly using:

Pen Tool

Pathfinder

Shape Builder

Clipping masks

Compound paths

Layers

Artboards

Typography

Vector illustration

Patterns

Gradients

Image tracing

Spot colors

Pantone colors

Bleeds

Cut paths

Production templates

Print-ready files

Keyboard shortcuts are expected.



If you need to search through menus to perform basic Illustrator functions, this position is probably not for you.

Adobe Photoshop

You should be highly skilled with:

Photo editing

Retouching

Masking

Color correction

Compositing

Mockups

Smart Objects

Image manipulation

Raster artwork

Large-format graphics

Production-ready artwork

Adobe InDesign

Strong experience with:

Brochures

Flyers

Catalogs

Multi-page documents

Marketing materials

Typography

Print layouts

Preflight

Print-ready PDFs

Additional Software Knowledge Is a Plus

Experience with any of the following is valuable:

Adobe Acrobat Pro

CorelDRAW

Figma

Canva

Procreate

Adobe Lightroom

After Effects

Premiere Pro

3D or mockup software

RIP software

Large-format production software

AI design tools

Other professional graphics software

You do not need to know every program listed above, but you must be technically strong and able to learn new software quickly.



WHAT YOU MAY BE DESIGNING

One day you may design a fully sublimated sports jersey.

The next project could be a vehicle wrap.

Then a brochure.

Then a T-shirt.

Then a banner.

Then business cards.

Then a complete branded marketing piece.

You should be comfortable designing:

Dye sublimation shirts

Sports jerseys

Team uniforms

Fishing shirts

Racing jerseys

Custom apparel

T-shirt graphics

Vehicle wraps

Vehicle lettering

Signs

Banners

Window graphics

Trade-show graphics

Business cards

Flyers

Brochures

Posters

Sales sheets

Marketing materials

Logos

Branding

Digital graphics

Promotional graphics

Versatility is extremely important.



SUBLIMATION EXPERIENCE

Professional dye sublimation apparel experience is strongly preferred.

You should understand:

All-over-print apparel

Sublimation templates

Cut-and-sew layouts

Front/back/sleeve design

Sponsor and logo placement

Names and numbers

Pattern development

Production layouts

Apparel mockups

Production-ready sublimation files



YOU MUST UNDERSTAND PRODUCTION

Being creative is not enough.

Your files must actually work when they reach production.

You should understand:

CMYK vs. RGB

Pantone and spot colors

Bleeds

Safe areas

DPI and resolution

Raster vs. vector

Font outlining

Embedded and linked artwork

Transparency

Print-ready PDFs

Large-format production

Sublimation production

Screen-printing considerations

Vehicle templates

Cut paths

File setup

Preflight

We do not want designers whose files constantly need to be repaired before production.



SPEED MATTERS

We are a high-volume production company.

We are busy.

Very busy.

We need designers who can work fast without sacrificing quality.

We are not looking for someone who takes all day to complete a basic project.



We need the combination of:

CREATIVITY + SPEED + ACCURACY + PRODUCTION KNOWLEDGE

RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:

Create original graphic designs

Design sublimated apparel

Design T-shirts

Create vehicle wraps

Design signs and banners

Design commercial print materials

Create branded marketing materials

Build customer proofs and mockups

Prepare production-ready artwork

Recreate or clean up customer artwork

Make revisions quickly

Follow templates and production specifications

Collaborate with our creative and production teams

Manage multiple projects simultaneously

Maintain organized files

Meet deadlines

Maintain a high standard of design quality



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



DO NOT APPLY unless you meet these requirements:

Minimum 5 years professional graphic design experience

Expert Adobe Illustrator skills

Strong Photoshop skills

Strong InDesign skills

Strong typography and layout skills

Strong understanding of color and composition

Professional print-production knowledge

Ability to work quickly

Ability to handle multiple projects

Excellent attention to detail

Strong English communication

Reliable computer

Reliable high-speed internet

Dependable attendance

Ability to work independently



POSITION DETAILS

Full-time

40 hours per week

Monday through Friday

Remote

Permanent, long-term position

High-volume workflow

Growing international company

Paid vacation during Christmas break

We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-ter
mber of our team, not someone looking for temporary freelance work.



HOW TO APPLY

Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Your application must include:

Resume

Portfolio link

At least 10 examples of your best work

If you claim sublimation experience, include at least 10 sublimation apparel designs

Examples showing multiple design categories are strongly preferred

Short video introducing yourself and speaking English

Briefly describe your experience with:

Illustrator

Photoshop

InDesign

Dye sublimation

Commercial printing

Vehicle wraps / large-format graphics



IMPORTANT

We are not looking for an average designer.

We want someone who is exceptionally good at what they do.

Someone who can be given a project with minimal direction and figure it out.

Someone who can create from scratch.

Someone who understands what looks good.

Someone who understands how artwork gets produced.

Someone who works fast.

Someone who catches mistakes.

Someone who takes pride in their work.

And most importantly:



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CAN DESIGN ALMOST ANYTHING WE PUT IN FRONT OF THEM — AND DO IT VERY WELL.

If that describes you, send us your portfolio.



Show us what you can do.

title: Client Sales Representative – ( MUST SPEAK PERFECT ENGLISH ) Printing, Signage & Apparel ( with Philippines Support )
description:
Inside Sales Representative – Printing, Signage & Apparel (Philippines-Support)

Position Type: Work From Home



Focus: Telephone/virtual sales, lead qualification, order entry, client relationships for apparel, signage, graphics.

Products: Sublimation apparel, screen print apparel, DTF/DTG, business cards, flyers & mailers, floor graphics, wall graphics, vehicle/boat graphics, large format signage.



Who you are: A highly motivated inside sales rep with experience in B2B printing/apparel/graphics sales or willing to learn quickly. You’re comfortable on the phone, via video calls, handling leads and managing client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:



Respond to inbound leads 
, web-form, phone) and qualify prospects for production of apparel/signage/graphics.

Make outbound calls to warm leads and existing client base to cross-sell apparel, signage, vehicle/boat graphics, promotional graphics.



Prepare quotes, proposals, follow up until close.
