Excellent phone, email and communication skills; ability to build relationships virtually.

Some knowledge or strong interest in apparel decoration (sublimation, screen print, DTF/DTG) and graphics/signage solutions.



Comfortable working from home in the Philippines or in a high-performance environment.

Experience using CRM is a plus; comfortable with quoting/order entry.



What we offer:

Full time position. No gig work.

Base salary

Remote/virtual role: flexible location 

Training on our product mix (apparel + signage + graphics) to get you selling quickly.



How to Apply:

Reply to this post with video of yourself talking so we can hear your English, include your resume, detail your inside sales experience (especially in printing/apparel/graphics if applicable).



Include a short explanation on Why you believe you can generate new business in the apparel/graphics/signage market.

Include your preference on compensation structure.

title: Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead
description:
We have ambitious plans to grow rapidly. Our entire ecosystem has been divided into 4 new positions. We are looking for people who have the knowledge and experience to join our team and take our 23 year old company to the next level.



Feel free to browse our 4 open positions, but do not apply to any if you do not have the experience required. Thanks you.



Here they are:



1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead

2. Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Performance Specialist

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



This ad is for position #4

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



Paid Social • Ecommerce Growth • Customer Acquisition • Retargeting • Lifecycle Marketing

Full-Time Permanent Position — 40 Hours Per Week

JOB OVERVIEW



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company looking for an exceptional Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead.



This is NOT a social-media posting position.

This is NOT a content-creator position.

We have separate employees responsible for creative production and staff who can assist with repetitive posting and routine engagement.



We are looking for the marketing brain.

You will be responsible for determining:



WHO we should market to.

WHAT we should market to them.

WHERE we should reach them.

WHEN we should reach them.

WHAT offer they should see.

WHAT stage of the buying journey they are in.

HOW much we should spend acquiring them.

HOW we bring them back if they don't purchase.

HOW we turn first-time customers into repeat customers.

WHETHER the marketing actually made money.



Our objective is not followers.

Our objective is profitable growth.



YOUR MISSION

Build a sophisticated digital customer-acquisition and retention engine capable of helping scale our company toward $10+ million in annual revenue.



No single employee can guarantee that revenue.



Your responsibility is to build, operate and continuously improve the digital-marketing systems that can help us get there.



The system should move customers through:



Awareness > Interest > Consideration > Visit > Lead/Cart > Purchase > Repeat Purchase > Referral



You will work closely with:



Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

Technical/Ecommerce SEO Lead

Paid Search Specialist

Management

Sales/customer-service staff

Social-media VA's



1. DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the complete social/digital marketing strategy.



Determine how we should use:



Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Pinterest

LinkedIn


SMS

Influencers

Creators

Customer lists

Retargeting

Marketing automation

Landing pages

CRM data



Do not advertise somewhere merely because it exists.



You must explain:



Why we're using it

Who we're targeting

What outcome we expect

How we're measuring it



2. CUSTOMER & MARKET SEGMENTATION

We sell products that can appeal to very different customers.



For custom shirts, examples may include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Contractors

Churches

Companies

Events

Clubs

Nonprofits

Family reunions

Gyms

Retail businesses



For yard signs:

Realtors

Contractors

Landscapers

Schools

Events

Graduations

Businesses

Political campaigns where appropriate

Property services

Community organizations



These audiences should NOT all receive the same advertisement.



Develop distinct:

Audiences

Messages

Offers

Creative briefs

Landing pages

Retargeting

Follow-up



3. CUSTOMER PERSONAS & BUYING INTENT



Understand:

Who buys

Why they buy

What problem they're solving

How quickly they need it

What prevents them from buying

What competitors they're considering

What matters most: price, speed, quality, convenience, service or customization

How often they reorder

What else they may purchase



Turn customer knowledge into marketing strategy.



4. META ADVERTISING



You must be highly experienced with:

Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

 Ads

Instagram Ads

Meta Pixel

Events Manager

Conversion API concepts

Custom audiences

Customer lists

Website audiences

Engagement audiences

Video audiences

Prospecting

Retargeting

Catalog ads where appropriate

Advantage+ tools where appropriate

Lookalike/similar audience strategies where available



You should know how to build campaigns from scratch and improve them over time.



5. TIKTOK MARKETING & ADVERTISING



Understand both organic TikTok behavior and TikTok Ads Manager.



Know how to:



Identify TikTok-native creative

Select objectives

Build campaigns

Develop audiences

Retarget

Test creative

Read performance

Use Pixel/Events data

Scale winners

Kill poor performers



Work closely with the Creative Lead to produce platform-native assets.



6. YOUTUBE



Develop opportunities through:



YouTube content

YouTube Shorts

Video advertising

Retargeting

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Customer-intent content



Determine which videos are brand-building and which are direct-response assets.



7. PINTEREST



Evaluate and utilize Pinterest when appropriate for visually driven products including:



Apparel

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING



Develop B2B opportunities where economically justified.



Potential audiences include:



Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

Schools

Organizations

Event companies

Contractors

Procurement teams



Determine when LinkedIn advertising makes financial sense and when organic outreach/content is more appropriate.



9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY



Own:



Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising + email/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.



Segment by:



Product purchased

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer



Use appropriately on supported platforms for:



Customer Match

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own email strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING



Build compliant SMS programs for:



Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns



Avoid destroying customer trust through excessive messaging.



16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:



Business cards > flyers.



Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.



Develop data-driven cross-sell and upsell campaigns.



17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:



CAC

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form > Email/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.



You DO need to understand what makes them convert.



Recommend:



Headlines

Offers

Layout

Social proof

Videos

Reviews

Calls to action

Forms

Product presentation

FAQs

Urgency

Guarantees

Mobile improvements



Work with our SEO/web team on implementation.



20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:



Percentage discounts

Dollar discounts

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

First-order incentives

Reorder incentives

Referral offers

Volume pricing

Seasonal promotions



Measure actual profitability.



21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING



Develop disciplined experiments around:



Creative

Hooks

Audiences

Offers

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

SMS

Retargeting windows

Campaign structures



Do not change ten things and then claim you learned something.



Test intelligently.



22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:



Zapier

CRM systems

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Webhooks/integrations where available

ManyChat

Other automation platforms



Example:


 Lead >



CRM >



Immediate SMS >



Immediate email >



Sales notification >



Follow-up >



Retargeting audience >



Conversion tracking.



23. CRM STRATEGY



Help organize customers/leads by:



Source

Product interest

Stage

Customer type

Purchase history

Value

Follow-up status



Marketing should become smarter as our customer database grows.



24. INFLUENCER & CREATOR MARKETING



Own the business side of influencer/creator campaigns.



You determine:



Which creators make sense

Audience fit

Expected economics

Compensation structure

Affiliate opportunities

Tracking

Offers/codes

Content usage rights

Performance



Creative Lead owns/supports creative direction.



25. ORGANIC SOCIAL STRATEGY



Our VAs can perform repetitive posting.



You determine:



Platform strategy

Posting priorities

Content mix

Frequency

Campaign themes

Promotions

Audience development

Growth opportunities



Do not spend your entire day manually posting.



Your value is strategy and growth.



26. SOCIAL MEDIA VA MANAGEMENT



Create documented systems our VAs can execute.



Examples:



Posting calendar

Group-posting instructions

Response templates

Escalation rules

Comment procedures

Lead-capture procedures

CRM entry procedures



Use lower-cost execution resources intelligently so your own time remains focused on high-value marketing work.



27. ANALYTICS & ATTRIBUTION



Understand:



GA4

Meta attribution

TikTok attribution

Platform attribution differences

UTMs

Conversion events

CRM source data

Call tracking

Post-purchase surveys where useful

First-touch vs. last-touch

Assisted conversions



Do not blindly believe one dashboard.



Understand how measurement works.



28. CORE PERFORMANCE METRICS



You should be highly comfortable with:



Revenue

ROAS

MER

CPA

CAC

CPL

Cost per purchase

Conversion rate

Average order value

Customer lifetime value

Repeat purchase rate

CTR

CPC

CPM

Frequency

 revenue

SMS revenue



You must be able to explain these numbers to management in plain English.



29. BUDGET ALLOCATION



Recommend how marketing dollars should be distributed.



Example:



If Meta is producing 5X ROAS and TikTok is producing 1.2X, do not continue equal budgets because the original spreadsheet said so.



Evaluate:



Scalability

Incremental performance

Margins

Acquisition cost

Customer quality

Lifetime value

Seasonality



Move money intelligently.



30. SCALING



You must understand the difference between:



"A campaign works at $50/day" and: "We can profitably scale this campaign to $5,000/day."



Scaling requires monitoring:



Audience saturation

Frequency

CPA

Creative fatigue

Conversion rate

Inventory/capacity

Customer economics



31. COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE



Continuously study competitors.



Analyze:



Offers

Advertisements

Creative

Landing pages

Promotions

Social channels

Reviews

Positioning

Customer complaints

Influencers

Funnels

 capture

Retargeting



Find gaps we can exploit.



32. NEW GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES



We expect you to continually ask:



"What aren't we doing?"



Examples could include:



New customer segments

New channels

Affiliate programs

Referral programs

Partnership marketing

Creator partnerships

Lead magnets

New funnels

Reorder programs

Loyalty

B2B campaigns

Geographic campaigns

Seasonal opportunities



We want proactive thinking.



WHAT YOU OWN



You OWN:



Digital marketing strategy

Social marketing strategy

Paid social

Audience strategy

Customer segmentation

Retargeting

Customer-list marketing

Campaign architecture

Media buying

Budget allocation

Funnel strategy

Offers

 strategy

SMS strategy

Lifecycle marketing

Marketing automation

CRM marketing strategy

Influencer economics

Conversion analysis

Attribution

Social marketing reporting

ROAS/CPA optimization

Growth experiments

WHAT THE CREATIVE LEAD OWNS



The Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead owns:



Creative concepts

Scripts

Hooks development

Photography direction

Static advertisements

Video advertisements

Reels

Shorts

TikToks

UGC creative direction

Editing

Creative variations



You provide the marketing requirements.



They turn those requirements into exceptional advertising.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



We prefer 5+ years of serious digital/performance marketing experience.



You should have substantial experience with:



Meta Ads

Ecommerce

Paid social

Retargeting

Customer audiences

Conversion tracking

 marketing

SMS marketing

Funnels

Analytics

Marketing automation

Campaign testing

Scaling



We strongly prefer candidates who have managed substantial real advertising budgets and can demonstrate revenue—not merely followers or traffic.



TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic marketing cover letter.



Send:



1. PDF Resume

2. Advertising Results



Provide examples showing:



Spend

Revenue

ROAS

CPA

CAC

Leads

Purchases

Conversion rates



Explain exactly what YOU controlled.



3. Biggest Account



Tell us:



What company/product

Monthly spend

Platforms

Your responsibilities

Initial problem

What you changed

Result

4. Strategy Challenge



We want to sell custom dye-sublimated shirts nationwide.



Target possibilities include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Businesses

Clubs

Organizations

Events



If you had a $10,000 initial test budget.



Tell us:



Which audiences you test first.

Which platforms you use.

How you divide the budget.

What creative you request from our Creative Lead.

What landing pages/funnels you use.

What conversion events you track.

How you retarget non-buyers.

How you market again to purchasers.

What results determine whether you scale or stop.

What you do after the first 30 days.

5. Diagnostic Challenge



A Meta campaign has:



Excellent video engagement

Excellent CTR

Cheap CPC

Almost no purchases



Tell us what you investigate and why.



6. Scaling Challenge



One advertisement produces a 6X ROAS at $100/day.



What do you do next?



We are looking for someone who thinks like a growth marketer and business owner.



Not someone who simply knows how to operate Ads Manager.

title: High-Volume Wedding Photo Color Correction Artists (Lightroom + AI Workflow)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Role Type: Freelance / Contractor (Per-Gig / Per-Wedding Basis)

Capacity: Up to Full-Time Equivalent (~15 weddings/month per editor)



About the Role

We are a global wedding photography company seeking up to 4 reliable, detail-oriented photo color correction artists based in the Philippines.



In this role, you will handle the post-production color grading and correction pipeline, transforming RAW wedding captures into consistent, gallery-ready, high-resolution JPEGs that match our signature look.



We heavily leverage modern editing workflows—pairing Adobe Lightroom Classic with AI-assisted editing tools (AfterShoot) to achieve fast, cohesive results across diverse lighting and venue conditions.



Key Responsibilities

Color Correction & Exposure Balancing: Correct white balance, tint, exposure, highlights, shadows, and skin tones across full wedding galleries (typically 1,500–4,000+ RAW images per wedding).



AI-Assisted Workflow Integration: Run catalogs through AI profiles, then perform meticulous manual QC and secondary adjustments to ensure every frame is cohesive.



Volume & Consistency: Successfully turnaround an average of 12–15 weddings per month while adhering strictly to our brand presets and style guides.



Export & Delivery: Export optimized high-resolution JPEGs following exact file-naming, sizing, and sharpening protocols within agreed deadlines.



Feedback Implementation: Apply constructive client feedback and make timely revisions when required.



Requirements & Qualifications

Proven Experience: Demonstrable portfolio or track record editing high-volume event/wedding galleries.



Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in Adobe Lightroom Classic (smart previews, catalogs, batch editing) and hands-on familiarity with AI culling/editing software (ImagenAI, AfterShoot, or similar).



Color Sensitivity: Sharp eye for natural, flattering skin tones across diverse skin complexions and varying light environments (direct sun, golden hour, tungsten, reception flash).



Hardware & Connectivity:



High-performance PC or Mac capable of smoothly handling large RAW files and catalog batches.



Color-accurate, calibrated monitor.



Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50+ Mbps download/upload) with a dependable backup plan for power and internet interruptions.



Work Ethic: Strong time management, high reliability, and clear written English communication.



Compensation & Work Setup

Pay Structure: Paid per gig / per wedding completed (rates discussed upon application).



Volume: Steady flow of projects throughout the peak wedding seasons, with potential for long-term ongoing collaboration.



Flexible Hours: Work on your own schedule as long as delivery milestones (typically 1 week turnaround per gallery once assigned) are consistently met.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit the following:



Portfolio / Before-and-Afters: A link to a portfolio or Google Drive showing before-and-after samples of your wedding color correction work (particularly skin tone rendering and reception lighting).



Workflow Summary: A quick overview of your current tech setup (computer specs, monitor, internet speed) and which AI editing tools you use regularly.



Capacity: Your current monthly editing availability.



Paid Trial: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid test gallery to evaluate style matching, color consistency, and turnaround speed.

title: Video Editor
description:
YouTube Video Editor – Simple Long-Form Videos ($3–$4/Hour)



Job Type: Full-Time, Long-Term



Pay: $3–$4 USD per hour (negotiable per video)



Video Length: 10–20 minutes



Workload: Goal of 1 completed YouTube video per day



Job Description



Hey! I'm looking for a reliable, affordable YouTube video editor to work with me long-term on my growing YouTube channel.



My channel focuses on remote jobs, making money online, and overemployment.



I'm looking for someone who can edit simple, clean, engaging YouTube videos. Nothing overly complicated or cinematic.



Most videos will consist of me talking to the camera while explaining a topic, reviewing Reddit posts, showing websites, or walking through different online tools.



What You'll Be Doing



- Cutting out mistakes, pauses, and unnecessary sections.

- Adding relevant B-roll, screenshots, and screen recordings.

- Showing Reddit posts, websites, and articles while I'm discussing them.

- Adding simple zooms, transitions, and occasional text.

- Keeping the pacing engaging without excessive effects.

- Making sure audio sounds clean and balanced.

- Delivering finished 1080p YouTube videos.



What I'm NOT Looking For



- Complicated animations or motion graphics.

- Excessive sound effects or flashy transitions.

- Overly cinematic editing.

- Someone who spends hours on unnecessary effects.



I want clean, professional, simple editing that's efficient to produce.



Requirements



- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

- Comfortable using CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

- Able to understand English and match visuals to what I'm saying.

- Good communication and consistent delivery.

- Able to work independently and follow reference videos.

- Looking for a long-term opportunity.



Pay & Workload



My budget is approximately $3–$4/hour, ideally $20–$40 per completed 15-minute video depending on complexity.



I plan to produce videos consistently, with a goal of posting one video every day.



This is a long-term opportunity with steady work for the right person.



How to Apply



Please send me:



1. Your portfolio with examples of long-form YouTube videos you've edited.

2. Your hourly rate.

3. How much you would charge to edit a simple 15-minute YouTube video.

4. How many hours you typically need to complete one.

5. How many videos you can realistically edit per week.

6. Which editing software you use.



Important: Start your application with the word "REDDIT" so I know you read the entire description.



I'll be selecting a few applicants for a short paid trial edit before hiring.



Looking forward to working together!

title: TikTok video editor
description:
JOB TITLE

TikTok Shop Video Editor (CapCut): 7–8 Short Videos a Day, Women 45+ Beauty



TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT

Part-time



WAGE / SALARY

$600 USD per month



HOURS PER WEEK

25–30



JOB DESCRIPTION



Hi! I'm Kelly, a full-time TikTok Shop creator with about 31,000 followers, mostly women 45 and up. I post 7 to 8 short videos a day on beauty, skincare, haircare, wellness and fashion. I need a reliable editor to help me through the holiday season, with steady work after that if we're a good fit.



What you'll do

- Edit up to 55 vertical videos a week, mostly 15 to 90 seconds, with skincare bundle videos running up to 3 minutes

- Cut out pauses, retakes and mistakes, keeping my best take of each line

- Keep the pacing fast and natural

- Add captions of what I say, in my style

- Place overlays where my note tells you: product photos, shop screenshots, demo clips, text, zooms and split screens

- Add a trending or background sound when I ask

- Export at 1080x1920 with no watermark



How it works

Each day I upload my raw clips to one shared Google Drive folder for that day, named by product and number (like "Tideway-2"). My overlay notes for every video live in one shared Google Doc. You send the finished videos back within 24 hours. I review everything and post it myself.



Important

Only add the on-screen text I write in my notes, word for word. Never add product claims, prices, "sale" or "link in bio." These rules protect my TikTok Shop account.



You need

- Strong CapCut skills

- Experience with TikTok, Reels or Shorts editing

- Good English

- Reliable internet and backup power

- Availability 6 days a week



Pay

- $600 USD a month for up to 55 videos a week, paid every two weeks by Wise or PayPal

- $3 per extra video over 55

- $300 December bonus if you keep the 24-hour turnaround all month

- Raise review after 3 months



Trial

Three paid test edits at $5 each, whether or not I hire you. Then a 2-week paid trial.



To apply

Send 2 to 3 short-form videos you've edited, how long each one took, and your available hours in US Eastern time. Put "Orange Cart" in your subject line so I know you read the whole post.



SKILLS TO TAG

Video Editing, CapCut, Short-Form Video, TikTok, Social Media Content, Captions/Subtitles

description:

Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00pm–3:00am Manila time (20 hours a week)

Location: Work from home

Type: Independent contractor, 30-day paid trial, if successful; long-term

Start: Immediately



ABOUT THE WORK



I'm a US-based business owner with residential rental properties in the US. You'll join a small team and work from a ticket board: each task comes with written instructions, and you post your progress and results back on the ticket.



Most of the job is calling and
ing US businesses and getting a clear, written answer. A typical week includes:



• Vendors and property maintenance: booking HVAC, plumbing, irrigation, pest control and handyman work, and getting written, itemized quotes before anyone is sent out. You'll coordinate access with tenants and keep a maintenance log for each property.

• Calls to insurers, utilities and agencies: auto and home insurance claims, the DMV, utility billing errors, and changing the mailing address on accounts. Many of these calls mean waiting on hold, then getting the result in writing.

• Refunds and disputes: chasing refunds for cancelled subscriptions, airline credits and wrong charges, and cancelling services we no longer use.

• Scheduling: medical and dental appointments, service visits and meetings. You confirm every person involved and the time zone before you book anything.

• Room rentals: posting and renewing listings, answering inquiries, running screening calls and coordinating showings.

• Documents and signatures: preparing letters and forms, sending documents out for e-signature and following up until they're signed.

• Payables and bookkeeping support: collecting invoices, W-9s and receipts, matching them to statements, splitting shared bills, and preparing the weekly payment run for approval. You will not have access to bank accounts.

• Research: finding and comparing two or three local providers (contractors, professionals, service companies) and writing up a short side-by-side comparison.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US companies and writing updates I act on without needing to call you.

• Experience as a VA or in admin work. Experience with property management, insurance or medical offices is a plus.

• Accounting background preferred. A degree in accountancy or a related field (BSA, BSMA, BS Accounting Technology) is a plus. So is experience with bookkeeping, accounts payable, reconciliations or QuickBooks.

• Comfortable making outbound calls to US businesses, including through phone trees and hold queues

• Organized and persistent. A task isn't done when you've sent an
. It's done when the answer is in writing and posted on the ticket.

• You are able to follow written procedures 

• Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a computer (you will be provided a USA phone number)

• Able to keep personal and financial information strictly confidential



Tools we use (we'll train you): a project/ticket board, a US business phone and texting app, e-signature software, Google Docs and Sheets, team chat, Gmail. If you've used Jira, Trello, Asana, Monday or something similar, you'll pick this up quickly.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any of these won't be read.



1. Put "WRITTEN ANSWER" as the first line of your message.

2. Tell me where you're based, confirm you can reliably work the hours above, and list any accounting education or experience.

3. Describe, in 5–8 sentences, a time you had to get a problem resolved by a company that kept giving you the runaround: what you did, and how it ended.

4. Write a short status update for this scenario, as if posting it on the ticket:

   "You called a plumbing company to get a quote for a leaking water heater. They said about $400 on the phone but won't commit in writing until a technician visits, and the visit costs $89. The tenant can only be home after 4pm on weekdays."

title: Senior US Litigation Docketing & Deadline Control Specialist
description:
Senior US Litigation Docketing & Deadline Control Specialist



Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | $1,200–$2,000 USD per Month (Depending on Experience)



About Our Firm



We are a growing California-based law firm seeking an experienced US Litigation Docketing and Deadline Control Specialist to oversee and independently verify litigation deadlines across our practice.



Our firm handles civil litigation matters in California state and federal courts. We have an established team of attorneys, paralegals, and administrative personnel and are continuing to expand.



We are looking for an exceptionally organized, detail-oriented professional who can take ownership of our firm's deadline monitoring and verification processes.



This is not a general virtual assistant or basic calendar management position. We are seeking someone with actual US civil litigation experience.



Position Overview



The Docket Specialist will serve as the firm's central deadline-control and auditing professional.



Our attorneys and paralegals will continue managing their individual cases, entering deadlines, and updating our case management systems. Your responsibility will be to independently verify that deadlines are accurate, properly assigned, monitored, and completed.



You will be responsible for identifying discrepancies, detecting potential missed deadlines, following up on unresolved matters, and escalating issues before they become problems.



You will report to senior administrative leadership and have direct escalation access to the responsible attorneys when critical deadline issues arise.



The objective is to establish a reliable system in which no litigation deadline goes unidentified, unassigned, unverified, or unreported.



Primary Responsibilities



1. Litigation Deadline Management



Review litigation calendars and upcoming deadlines across all active cases.



Review court orders, hearing notices, discovery requests, motions, service records, and other litigation documents.



Independently calculate or verify proposed deadlines under applicable California and federal procedural rules, subject to attorney approval.



Identify missing, conflicting, incorrectly calculated, or unassigned deadlines.



Ensure deadlines are accurately recorded in Clio Manage and the firm's management dashboard.



Monitor deadlines for discovery, motions, hearings, trial preparation, filings, and service requirements.



2. Independent Docket Auditing



Conduct daily audits of the firm's litigation calendar.



Compare Clio Manage, Microsoft SharePoint dashboards, court documents, and relevant communications.



Verify that each deadline has an assigned attorney and responsible staff member.



Identify deadlines that are approaching without documented progress.



Verify filing confirmations, proof of service, and other evidence that required actions were completed.



Maintain accurate records of discrepancies, corrections, and escalations.



3. Deadline Accountability and Escalation



Follow up with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative staff regarding approaching deadlines.



Identify tasks that have not been completed or acknowledged.



Escalate urgent deadlines directly to the responsible attorney and designated management.



Continue tracking unresolved issues until they are appropriately addressed.



Maintain written records of alerts, follow-ups, and acknowledgments.



Immediately report potential missed deadlines or serious calendaring discrepancies.



4. Reporting and Dashboard Management



Prepare a daily report identifying deadlines requiring attention.



Maintain a consolidated view of upcoming litigation deadlines.



Identify overdue tasks, missing documentation, and unresolved deadline risks.



Prepare weekly docket integrity reports for management.



Help improve the firm's existing SharePoint-based deadline tracking dashboard.



Recommend process improvements to reduce errors and improve accountability.



5. Systems and Process Improvement



Develop and maintain standardized docket-control procedures.



Establish consistent methods for verifying deadline entries and completion evidence.



Identify recurring weaknesses in the firm's calendaring processes.



Assist with implementing automation and AI-assisted workflows for identifying potential deadlines.



Ensure that automated deadline calculations and extracted information receive appropriate human verification.



Help build a scalable docketing system as the firm expands.



Minimum Qualifications — ALL Required



Applicants must meet every qualification below:



At least TWO (2) years of hands-on experience with US civil litigation docketing, calendaring, or litigation deadline management.



Experience working for a US law firm or US litigation practice.



Demonstrated experience reviewing court orders, discovery documents, and litigation deadlines.



Working knowledge of US civil litigation procedures and court deadlines.



Experience using legal practice management, docketing, or litigation calendaring software.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to independently identify discrepancies, follow up on unresolved issues, and escalate problems.



Ability to work during designated California business hours, including reliable coverage of critical deadlines.



Reliable internet access and an appropriate remote working environment.



Applicants who do not meet ALL minimum qualifications should not apply.



Preferred Qualifications



The following qualifications are strongly preferred but not mandatory:



Experience with California state court civil litigation.



Experience with federal civil litigation.



Familiarity with California Code of Civil Procedure deadlines and the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.



Experience with Clio Manage.



Experience with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Excel, and Power Automate.



Experience conducting independent litigation calendar audits.



Experience supporting multiple attorneys and substantial litigation caseloads.



Familiarity with electronic filing systems and court docket monitoring.



Experience creating operational reports and management dashboards.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be expected to:



Maintain a comprehensive and accurate docket-control process.



Ensure every identified critical deadline has an assigned attorney and staff owner.



Identify and promptly escalate potential deadline errors.



Verify completion of filings and other deadline-related tasks.



Maintain accurate documentation of follow-ups and escalations.



Deliver daily and weekly docket reports on time.



Help management identify and correct recurring calendaring problems.



You will be accountable for the accuracy and reliability of your assigned verification, monitoring, reporting, and escalation duties. Attorneys retain responsibility for legal deadline determinations and professional supervision.



Compensation and Schedule



Compensation: $1,200–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.



Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week.



Location: Remote – Philippines.



Schedule: Must be available during designated California business hours. The exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process.



We are seeking a long-term team member who wants to grow with an expanding US law firm.



Selection Process



Qualified applicants will participate in a structured hiring process that may include:



Review of relevant US litigation experience.



Written screening questions.



A paid practical litigation calendaring assessment.



A live video interview.



Employment and professional reference verification.



The practical assessment will involve fictional litigation documents and a sample calendar containing errors. Candidates will be evaluated on their ability to identify discrepancies, explain calculations, recognize uncertainty, and appropriately escalate issues.

8. Verify every statement for accuracy.

9. Never invent experience, accomplishments, companies, credentials, dates, or skills.

10. Proofread the finished resume before submitting it.



Each significant opportunity should receive an appropriately tailored resume rather than sending the exact same generic resume everywhere.



---



## 3. Job Applications



Manage the application process from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Completing applications

- Uploading the correct tailored resume

- Completing standard screening questions

- Maintaining accurate applicant information

- Saving job descriptions when necessary

- Recording application confirmation

- Tracking next steps

- Monitoring deadlines

- Preventing duplicate applications



Approximately 10 qualified applications should be completed per business day.



Applications requiring unusual legal declarations, salary commitments, assessments, recorded video responses, lengthy personality tests, contracts, or information that has not already been authorized should be flagged for me rather than guessed.



---



## 4. Application Tracking



Maintain a master Job Search Tracker.



Each application should include:



- Company

- Position

- Industry

- Location

- Remote/hybrid/on-site

- Salary or compensation range

- Job URL

- Source

- Date discovered

- Date applied

- Resume version used

- Application status

- Recruiter/hiring manager

- Contact information

- Follow-up date

- Interview date

- Interview stage

- Next action

- Notes

- Rejection/offer status



Application stages should be standardized, such as:



**Found → Reviewed → Approved → Resume Tailored → Applied → Follow-Up Due → Recruiter Contact → Interview → Final Interview → Offer / Rejected / Closed**



---



## 5. Follow-Ups



Do not allow submitted applications to simply disappear after submission.



Create and maintain a follow-up system.



Examples:



- Initial recruiter/hiring manager outreach

- Application follow-up

- Interview thank-you

- Interview follow-up

- Networking follow-up

- Mentorship follow-up

- Meeting follow-up



Track when each follow-up should happen and alert me when my involvement is required.



---



## 6. Professional Networking & Mentorship



Regularly research professionals I could learn from or build relationships with.



Priority industries include:



- E-commerce

- TikTok Shop/social commerce

- Influencer marketing

- Creator management

- Music business

- Artist management

- Music marketing

- Sales

- Business development

- AI

- Entrepreneurship

- Partnerships



Potential contacts may include:



- Executives

- Founders

- Directors

- Managers

- Experienced operators

- Sales leaders

- E-commerce professionals

- Creator managers

- Music executives

- Industry consultants



The objective is relationship building and mentorship—not mass spam.



For each strong contact:



1. Research their background.

2. Determine why the person is relevant to my goals.

3. Identify a legitimate point of connection.

4. Draft a personalized outreach message.

5. Track the outreach.

6. Schedule an appropriate follow-up.

7. Record responses and meetings.



Quality is more important than sending hundreds of generic messages.



---



## 7. Calendar & Schedule Management



Help manage my:



- Interviews

- Professional meetings

- Mentorship calls

- Business meetings

- Appointments

- Personal commitments

- Work obligations

- Deadlines

- Follow-ups

- Projects



Before adding or recommending a commitment, check my existing schedule.



The goal is not to fill every available hour.



My schedule should remain realistic and sustainable.



Consider:



- Travel time

- Preparation time

- Work commitments

- Business responsibilities

- Personal obligations

- Meals

- Sleep

- Recovery time

- Transition time between meetings

- Existing priorities



Flag scheduling conflicts before they become a problem.



---



## 8. Daily Executive Summary



At the end of each workday, send me a concise executive summary containing:



### Applications

- Jobs found

- Jobs applied to

- Companies

- Positions

- Important opportunities requiring my attention



### Follow-Ups

- Follow-ups completed

- Follow-ups due tomorrow

- Responses received



### Networking

- Professionals researched

- Outreach sent

- Responses

- Meetings scheduled



### Calendar

- Tomorrow's appointments

- Interviews

- Meetings

- Deadlines



### Action Required From Me

Clearly identify anything that requires my personal involvement.



Example:



**ACTION REQUIRED**

1. Complete assessment for Company A.

2. Review interview invitation from Company B.

3. Approve outreach message to executive at Company C.



---



## 9. Weekly Executive Check-In



At the beginning of each week, ask:



**"What are your goals and plans for this week?"**



Then help translate those goals into an achievable weekly schedule.



Review:



- Career priorities

- Job-search targets

- Interviews

- Networking goals

- Business priorities

- Personal obligations

- Appointments

- Deadlines

- Unfinished tasks from the previous week



The weekly plan should be realistic rather than overloaded.



---



# Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by organization and quality—not simply hours worked.



Key expectations include:



- Approximately 10 qualified job applications per business day

- Approximately 50 qualified applications per week when sufficient opportunities exist

- Applications accurately tracked

- No duplicate applications

- Resume customized when appropriate

- No fabricated resume information

- Important follow-ups completed on time

- Interviews and appointments properly tracked

- Schedule conflicts identified in advance

- Professional networking conducted consistently

- Daily summaries delivered consistently

- Weekly planning completed consistently



---



# Required Skills



The ideal candidate should be strong in:



- Online research

- Google Docs

- Google Sheets

- Google Calendar

- Gmail/email management

- LinkedIn

- Job boards

- ChatGPT/AI tools

- Resume editing

- Written English

- Professional communication

- Scheduling

- Organization

- Attention to detail

- Independent problem solving



You should be comfortable learning new AI tools and workflows.



Experience with recruiting, job-search assistance, executive assistance, sales recruiting, sourcing, LinkedIn outreach, career services, or business development is highly valuable.



---



# What I Do NOT Want



I am not looking for someone who:



- Blindly submits Easy Apply applications

- Uses the same resume for everything

- Mass-spams professionals

- Fabricates information with AI

- Applies to clearly unqualified jobs just to hit a quota

- Requires instructions for every small decision

- Loses track of follow-ups

- Overbooks my calendar

- Says a task is complete without verifying it

- Uses AI output without reviewing it



I want someone who can operate like an executive assistant and project manager.



---



# Ideal Personality



You are:



- Extremely organized

- Proactive

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Curious

- Resourceful

- Comfortable with technology

- Comfortable asking questions when information truly cannot be determined

- Capable of following detailed systems

- Able to notice inconsistencies

- Able to prioritize independently



Most importantly, you should be capable of thinking:



**"What needs to happen next?"**



instead of waiting for me to assign every next step.



---



# Application Instructions



When applying, please include:



1. Your executive/virtual assistant experience.

2. Your experience applying to jobs for clients.

3. Your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

4. Your experience with Google Docs and Sheets.

5. Your experience with LinkedIn research/outreach.

6. An example of a system you have used to manage recurring tasks or follow-ups.

7. Your weekly availability.

8. Your time zone.

9. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.



Please begin your application with the phrase:



**"Career Operations"**



so I know you carefully read the description.

title: Thumbnail Designer for YouTubers with 100M+ Subscribers (Photoshop + AI)
description:
What is the company?



We work with some of the largest YouTubers on earth, with channels of 100+ million subscribers.



We are a London-based startup that partners with the world's biggest creators.



What will you be doing?



You will be our core thumbnail designer, working directly with people who have built YouTube channels with millions of subscribers. You will learn from the very best in thumbnails and see up close what makes a video explode and what makes it flop.



You will also get access to our own AI thumbnail tools, built in-house by our development team specifically for high-performing YouTube thumbnails. These are tools you won't find anywhere else, and they let you create faster and at a higher standard than designers working the traditional way.



Millions of viewers will see your thumbnails from your first week. Every design you make will be tested in the real world, at a scale most designers never get to experience.



This is not a slow, comfortable role. You will need to work hard and fast, deliver high-quality thumbnails on tight deadlines, and keep raising the bar. In return, you will grow faster here than anywhere else.



You may also be asked to design social graphics, ad creatives, and assets for our apps and brands.



Responsibilities include:



- Designing high-CTR YouTube thumbnails for some of the biggest channels in the world.

- Cutting out, retouching, and compositing faces, products, and scenes in Photoshop.

- Using our in-house AI tools to generate concepts, scenes, and assets faster without sacrificing quality.

- Giving feedback to our development team to help improve the AI tools you use every day.

- Producing multiple variations per video for A/B testing, and learning from the results.

- Keeping thumbnails consistent with each channel's style while pushing for bold, fresh ideas.

- Researching trending thumbnails and competitor channels to spot what's working right now.

- Delivering quickly across several channels at once, without dropping quality.



About you



You are ambitious and hungry, and you want to become one of the best thumbnail designers in the world.



You thrive in fast-paced environments where speed, output, and results matter more than corporate processes. You are happy to put in the work because you know this kind of opportunity is rare.



You should be:



- Highly skilled in Photoshop (cutouts, colour grading, lighting, compositing).

- Comfortable working with AI image tools and quick to learn new ones. We will train you on our in-house tools.



What is the best YouTube thumbnail you have ever seen and why did it work?



- Someone with a portfolio of real YouTube thumbnails. Experience with large channels or creators is a big plus.

- Obsessed with what makes people click: faces, emotion, contrast, curiosity, and simplicity.

- Fast. You can take a brief and turn it into a great thumbnail quickly, then do it again.

- Open to direct feedback and eager to learn from people at the top of the game.

- Organised and disciplined, delivering on time and communicating clearly.

- Excited by YouTube, the creator economy, and building from scratch.



Pay and hours



Pay: $1,000/month with performance-based bonuses.

Hours: 40 hours per week (exclusive of breaks).



This is your chance to design for the biggest channels on the planet, learn from the best in the business, use AI tools nobody else has, and help build a channel with experts.

title: YouTube + Social Media Manager
description:
EXPERIENCED YOUTUBE & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

Full-Time | Long-Term | $900–$1,200 USD/month

Real Estate Experience Preferred



ABOUT US



We are a growing real estate brand based in the Chicago suburbs, looking for an experienced and creative YouTube & Social Media Manager to join our team long-term.



We produce YouTube videos, Instagram Reels, local community content, and real estate marketing materials.



We need someone who can take raw footage and ideas and turn them into polished, engaging content, from editing and design all the way through publishing.



This is NOT an entry-level position or just a video editing job.



We are looking for someone with proven experience who can think creatively, work independently, and take ownership of our content.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



1. YOUTUBE (OUR MAIN PRIORITY)



- Edit long-form YouTube videos from raw footage

- Create professional, engaging videos with good pacing and storytelling

- Design clickable thumbnails

- Research and suggest strong video titles

- Write descriptions, optimize, and publish videos

- Understand CTR, audience retention, and YouTube analytics

- Recommend improvements based on video performance



We want someone who can suggest 2–3 thumbnail ideas and explain WHY they might work, not someone who waits for us to tell them exactly what to create.



2. INSTAGRAM & SOCIAL MEDIA



- Edit Instagram Reels and short-form videos

- Create attractive, easy-to-read carousel posts

- Design social graphics and write captions

- Repurpose YouTube videos into social content

- Research Chicago suburbs, real estate trends, local businesses, and community news

- Suggest relevant content ideas

- Help organize and publish content consistently



We'll provide many of the ideas and examples initially. As you learn our brand, we expect you to start bringing your own suggestions.



3. MARKETING & DESIGN



- Canva graphics

- Postcards and flyers

- Buyer and seller guides

- PDFs and other marketing materials



Good design taste and attention to detail are essential.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should already have:



- Proven long-form YouTube editing experience

- Experience managing YouTube or social media accounts

- Strong thumbnail design skills

- Experience editing Reels and creating carousels

- Excellent Canva skills

- Understanding of YouTube growth and analytics

- Strong written English

- Ability to research independently

- Excellent attention to detail

- Good communication and organization

- Ability to meet deadlines and work without constant supervision



Most importantly, we want someone proactive.



Someone who notices mistakes before submitting work, brings new ideas, accepts feedback, and genuinely cares about producing quality content.



REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE IS A BIG PLUS



If you've worked with Realtors, real estate teams, brokerages, mortgage companies, or other real estate businesses, we want to see that work!



Candidates with proven real estate marketing experience will receive priority consideration.



ONE SMALL INSTRUCTION



To show that you've carefully read this posting, include the phrase "CHICAGO CONTENT CREATOR" somewhere in the first paragraph of your application.



Please do not skip this step.



COMPENSATION



$900–$1,200 USD/month, depending on your experience and abilities.



This is a full-time, long-term opportunity with room to grow.



We're looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team, not someone looking for a short-term project.



HOW TO APPLY



We are only considering applicants who can demonstrate previous experience.



A résumé alone is NOT sufficient.



Please include the following in your application:



1. YOUTUBE PORTFOLIO



Send links to 3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.



Tell us exactly what you did. Did you edit the full video, add graphics, handle sound, or manage the entire project?



2. THUMBNAILS & SOCIAL MEDIA



Send:



- 3 YouTube thumbnails you personally designed

- Examples of Instagram Reels and carousel posts you created

- Links to social media or YouTube accounts you worked on



3. PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE & RESULTS



Tell us about 1–2 clients or accounts you managed.



For each, explain:



- What business or industry they were in

- What you personally handled

- How long you worked with them

- Any results you achieved (views, CTR, growth, engagement, leads, etc.)



Screenshots or other proof of results are encouraged.



Be specific about your role. We want to understand your actual experience, not just see a list of accounts.



4. SHORT VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Send a 2–3 minute Loom or similar video answering:



- What experience do you have with YouTube and social media?

- What are your strongest skills?

- Have you worked with real estate clients?

- Why do you think you're a good fit for this position?



5. SHOW US HOW YOU THINK



Our market includes Arlington Heights, Palatine, Barrington, Northbrook, Glenview, and other Chicago suburbs.



Suggest 2 specific YouTube or Instagram content ideas for our local real estate audience.



We want creative, relevant ideas, not generic home-buying tips.



6. AVAILABILITY



Tell us:



- Are you currently working with other clients?

- How many hours per week are you available?

- What is your expected monthly compensation?

- When could you start?



OUR HIRING PROCESS



Step 1: We review your application, portfolio, and proven experience.



Step 2: Selected applicants will receive raw video footage from our real estate content to complete an editing test.



You'll work with the actual type of footage we create so we can evaluate your editing skills, creativity, pacing, visual style, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions.



Step 3: Final interview and hiring decision.



We are looking for a reliable, talented person who takes pride in their work and wants to grow with our team.



If you have the skills and experience we're looking for, we look forward to reviewing your application!

I'm looking for a highly skilled, organized, creative, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant who can help me grow my real estate business by managing my digital marketing, website, social media, CRM, and lead follow-up systems.



I'm not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. I'm looking for someone who takes initiative, understands marketing strategies, pays attention to details, and can help me build an organized, efficient, and consistent business.

 marketing materials.

 marketing and automated campaigns.

 What I'm Looking For

title: WordPress SEO Specialist
description:
I own two established WordPress content sites, 
 (fishing) and 
 (recipes), and I’m hiring an intermediate SEO specialist to find what is holding back their Google rankings, fix the technical problems, and write clear SOPs. My full-time VA will handle the repetitive article updates using your SOPs, so I need someone who can diagnose problems, fix them, and explain them simply. You will report directly to me.



About the sites




: about 400 expert-written fishing articles with a solid backlink profile. Organic traffic is low, and about half its pages show as “crawled, currently not indexed” in Search Console.


: about 450 recipe articles, monetized with Mediavine. Most traffic comes from Pinterest, and I want to grow Google traffic carefully without putting current income at risk.



Phase 1, Months 1 to 2: AnglerWise



Technical SEO audit covering crawl, indexing, sitemaps, redirects, site speed and schema

Fix indexing problems, including no index rules for tag and attachment pages

Replace internal links that still point to an old redirected domain

Sort existing articles into four groups using Search Console data: quick win, refresh, consolidate or prune

Fully optimize 5 sample articles as examples: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links

Write a step-by-step SOP (Google Doc, Loom video welcome) so my VA can refresh the remaining articles



Phase 2, Month 3: StretchRecipes



Technical and on-page SEO audit

A prioritized list of fixes

Fully optimize 3 sample recipe articles as examples

An SOP for my VA to follow on the remaining recipes

No URL changes, no deleting or merging posts, and no changes to Mediavine ad settings without my written approval



After 3 months (if it is a good fit)



Continue at fewer hours: reviewing my VA’s work, checking Search Console, and setting next priorities



Requirements



At least 1 to 2 years of hands-on WordPress SEO experience, ideally on blogs or content sites

Comfortable with Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4 and Screaming Frog (or similar)

Familiar with Google’s helpful content and core update guidelines

No AI-generated content, no link buying, no black-hat SEO

Keep a written log of every redirect, no index and deletion

Good written English and a short weekly update



How to apply



Start your application with the word “Trout” so I know you read the full post.

Share one or two websites you have improved, with before-and-after results if you have them.

In 3 to 5 sentences, explain how you would fix a site where about half the pages are “crawled, currently not indexed.”



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task ($20): reviewing 5 URLs and recommending changes.

title: AI, 2D and 3D Video Editor
description:
## Job overview



We are looking for a genuinely high-level senior video editor and motion designer for a premium, cinematic mini-series in the personal-development space.



This is not standard social media editing. The series needs to feel like a high-end documentary meets a cinematic masterclass: visually bold, emotionally engaging, modern, and highly bingeable.



Depending on your skill set, your work may include AI scene generation, 2D and 3D animation,  building high-end motion graphics and kinetic typography, creating the visual effects to explain discussed concepts, designing transitions, or compositing/VFX. 



## What we’re looking for



- Experience in generating clones and re-creating entire scenes using AI

- Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills: long-form editing, story pacing, colour/audio fundamentals, and excellent project organisation.

- Strong After Effects skills: motion graphics, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects, and custom transitions.

- A portfolio showing cinematic long-form storytelling, premium branded content, documentaries, music videos, narrative YouTube, or similarly high-production work.

- Excellent taste in visual storytelling, pacing, music, sound design, typography, and contemporary design.

- Strong creative judgment: knowing when to use big visual moments and when to let an emotional moment breathe.

- Clear English communication, reliability, and the ability to take direction while bringing strong creative ideas to the table.



Big advantage: 3D, animation, or advanced VFX/compositing experience in Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. This is not essential if you are exceptional in editing and motion design, but please tell us about it if it is part of your skill set.



## This role is not for you if



Your work relies mainly on repetitive templates, generic social-media edits, auto-captions, or random stock footage. We are not looking for generic visuals, cheesy effects, PowerPoint-style explainers, or fast cutting for the sake of fast cutting.



We want a premium, intentional visual world with editorial taste, strong rhythm, and original ideas.



## What we offer



- A creatively ambitious project with a clear visual direction and strong existing footage library.

- The chance to work on a flagship cinematic series rather than high-volume, templated content.

- Potential for continued full-time long-form YouTube editing work after the project for the right person.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or showreel, with your 2–3 most relevant examples first.

2. A short note explaining your specific role in each example (editor, motion designer, VFX/compositor, etc.).

3. Your rate expectations or preferred project-pricing structure.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected AEST overlap.

title: YouTube Video Editor/ Uploader + Thumbnail Designer
description:
## YouTube Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer



We are looking for a reliable and efficient **YouTube Video Editor** to join our growing commentary channel.



This is a long-term position for someone who can edit consistently, follow an established style, communicate well, and handle a steady weekly production schedule.



Our channel focuses on commentary around viral internet stories, social trends, relationships, work/career topics, cost of living, and other relatable cultural discussions.



The editing style will **not be overly complex or effects-heavy**. We are looking for clean, engaging edits that keep the video moving and support the commentary.



### Weekly Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



- Editing approximately **7–10 long-form YouTube videos per week**

- Editing approximately **7 YouTube Shorts per week**

- Adding relevant source clips, images, screenshots, headlines, captions, zooms, and simple visual elements where needed

- Removing unnecessary pauses, mistakes, or dead space

- Maintaining good pacing throughout the videos

- Adding basic sound effects, music, or visual emphasis when appropriate

- Creating clickable **YouTube thumbnails**

- Uploading completed videos to our YouTube channel

- Adding the provided titles, descriptions, and other publishing information

- Making sure videos are properly formatted and ready for publishing

- Organizing video files and keeping the production workflow up to date



### Editing Style



The editing itself is relatively straightforward.



We are **not** looking for extremely complicated motion graphics, cinematic effects, or highly produced documentary-style editing.



The priority is:



- Clean cuts

- Good pacing

- Relevant B-roll/source clips

- Simple zooms and visual emphasis

- On-screen text when useful

- Keeping the viewer engaged without over-editing



Experience editing **YouTube commentary/reaction content** is strongly preferred.



### Working With the Team



You will work closely with our **Content Manager**, who will help organize the content pipeline and provide the source material, video direction, commentary angles, and other information needed for each video.



Communication and reliability are extremely important.



As the channel grows, we want the editor and Content Manager to develop an efficient workflow together so videos can move smoothly from:



**Research → Recording → Editing → Thumbnail → Upload**



### Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



- Has previous YouTube video editing experience

- Understands pacing and audience retention

- Can edit both long-form videos and Shorts

- Can create strong YouTube thumbnails

- Is comfortable working with a high volume of weekly content

- Can follow an established editing style

- Can meet deadlines consistently

- Communicates clearly and responds reliably

- Has a stable internet connection

- Can upload and manage videos inside YouTube Studio

- Is interested in working with the channel long term



You may use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or another professional editing program as long as you can produce consistent results.



### Compensation



**$500 USD per month / $125 USD per week**



This is intended to be a consistent, long-term position for the right person.



There will also be opportunities to take on more responsibility as the channel grows.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience

2. Links to **2–3 YouTube videos you have personally edited**

3. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you have created

4. What editing software you use

5. Your typical turnaround time for a 10–20 minute YouTube video

6. Your availability and how many hours per week you can work



Please also start your application with the words **“YouTube Editor”** so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the team rather than simply complete individual editing projects. working between 14-20 hours per week.



If you are reliable, efficient, understand YouTube, and want consistent long-term work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:

**Specializing in GoHighLevel, Meta Ads &
 Marketing**



**Position:** Part-Time Virtual Assistant / Digital Marketing Specialist  

**Location:** Remote  

**Hours:** 10–15 hours per week initially, with opportunities to grow  

**Compensation:** Based on experience



## About Us



I'm Dr. Jake Huebner, the owner and founder of Colorado Muscle & Joint Clinic and Back to Strong.



I run a healthcare and rehabilitation business focused on helping people overcome pain, improve movement, build strength, and get back to doing the things they enjoy.



As my businesses continue to grow, I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and experienced Virtual Assistant who can help manage and improve our digital marketing systems.



**I'm not looking for someone who simply follows instructions. I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, identify opportunities for improvement, and help our businesses grow.**



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, and
 marketing platforms such as Mailchimp.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. GoHighLevel CRM & Marketing Automation



- Manage and maintain our GoHighLevel CRM.

- Build, edit, and troubleshoot automated workflows.

- Create
 and SMS follow-up sequences.

- Manage lead capture forms, funnels, and landing pages.

- Organize contacts, tags, pipelines, and lead lists.

- Monitor incoming leads and ensure automations function correctly.

- Integrate website forms and other marketing tools with GoHighLevel.

- Identify opportunities to improve lead conversion and follow-up processes.

 marketing tools.

- Write and format professional, engaging marketing
s.

- Monitor open rates, click-through rates, and conversions.

- Conduct A/B testing to improve campaign performance.

- Maintain organized contact lists and respect unsubscribe preferences.



### 3. Meta Ads Management 
 & Instagram)

 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Set up campaigns, ad sets, audiences, and advertisements.

- Help configure Meta Pixel and website conversion tracking.

- Monitor advertising performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Track cost per lead, conversions, and advertising spend.

- Test different ad creatives, headlines, and audiences.

- Assist with retargeting campaigns where appropriate.

- Provide regular reports on advertising results.

- Troubleshoot rejected ads, tracking issues, and campaign setup problems.



### 4. General Marketing & Administrative Support



- Help organize and execute marketing projects.

- Coordinate campaign launches across multiple platforms.

- Assist with landing page updates and website improvements.

- Maintain organized marketing assets and campaign documentation.

- Research marketing strategies and opportunities.

- Communicate regularly about project progress and results.

- Proactively recommend improvements to existing systems.



## Required Qualifications



We're looking for someone with:



- **Hands-on GoHighLevel experience** — building workflows, managing contacts, and troubleshooting automations.

- **Meta Ads Manager experience** — creating, monitoring, and optimizing
 and Instagram campaigns.

- *
 marketing experience** — preferably with Mailchimp and GoHighLevel.

- Strong written English and communication skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

- Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Experience with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and basic reporting.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience working with healthcare, chiropractic, rehabilitation, or fitness businesses.

- Experience with Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and lead generation funnels.

- Familiarity with website builders such as Lovable.

- Experience connecting platforms using webhooks, Zapier, or Make.

- Basic copywriting and
 design skills.

- Experience with lead nurturing, CRM pipelines, and appointment booking automation.



## What I'm Looking For



I value three things above everything else:



**1. Initiative**



I want someone who can recognize opportunities and solve problems without needing detailed instructions for every task.



**2. Attention to Detail**



Our marketing systems need to work correctly. Whether it's an
 campaign, a lead capture form, or an advertising funnel, accuracy matters.



**3. Accountability**



I want someone who takes responsibility for their work, communicates consistently, and follows through on commitments.



You don't need to know everything, but you do need to be resourceful, organized, and willing to figure things out.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 30–60 days, I would like this person to:



- Become familiar with our GoHighLevel setup and existing automations.

- Help launch
 campaigns to appropriate previous-patient and prospective-client audiences.

- Ensure all website leads are captured and followed up with correctly.

- Assist with launching and monitoring Meta advertising campaigns.

- Create a simple weekly marketing performance report.

- Identify and implement improvements to our marketing systems.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your experience.

2. Examples of GoHighLevel workflows or automations you've built.

3. Your experience managing Meta advertising campaigns.

4. Examples of
 marketing campaigns you've created.

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

6. A brief explanation of how you would approach improving lead generation and follow-up for a healthcare business.



**Important:** Please begin your application with the words **"Marketing Systems"** so I know you've read the entire description.



I'm looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship who wants to grow alongside the businesses.

title: Part-Time CapCut Video Editor & Clip Sourcer (TikTok & Instagram Reels)
description:
I'm looking for a reliable, motivated part-time video editor to help scale my social media operation, primarily on TikTok and Instagram Reels.



The content consists mainly of short videos, typically around 6 seconds long. The editing process is straightforward, and I'll provide examples and instructions so you can learn the exact style and workflow.



I'm looking for someone who can replicate this format efficiently, find suitable clips and consistently deliver content.



This is intended to be a long-term working relationship. I'm looking for someone dependable who wants to grow alongside the business.



Responsibilities



Edit short-form videos using CapCut.



Source suitable clips for videos based on my instructions and examples.



Follow the examples and replicate the established editing style.



Add text, music or simple effects where required.



Prepare videos in the correct format for TikTok and Instagram Reels.



Organise completed videos into designated folders.



Meet agreed production targets and deadlines.



Communicate progress and ask questions when instructions are unclear.



Make reasonable revisions when needed.



Clip Sourcing



Basic experience finding suitable clips online is preferred.



I'll provide examples of the type of content I'm looking for and explain the sourcing process. You should be comfortable researching content, identifying relevant clips and organising the material for editing.



You don't need to be an expert researcher, but you should be resourceful, detail-oriented and willing to learn.



Only use sources and material that I'm authorised to use, and follow the sourcing instructions provided.



Requirements



Basic experience using CapCut.



Familiarity with TikTok and Instagram Reels.



Some experience sourcing clips or finding content online.



Ability to follow instructions and replicate examples.



Good attention to detail.



Reliable internet connection.



Good communication and time-management skills.



Willingness to learn and accept feedback.



Advanced editing skills are not required. The content is simple, so efficiency, consistency and the ability to follow the workflow are the main priorities.



Workload and Compensation



This is a part-time position with a starting budget of $150–$180 USD per month, depending on the agreed workload and experience.



Weekly hours and production targets will be agreed upon before employment begins.



The overall social media operation aims to publish at least 16 posts per day. Your responsibilities will focus on sourcing and editing the video assets required for the content plan.

Applicants who make the shortlist will be asked to complete paid trial tasks.



These will help me assess your ability to source suitable clips, follow instructions, edit efficiently and produce content in the required style.

Payments will be made exclusively through PayPal.



Please apply only if you're comfortable receiving payments through PayPal. Payment frequency and any applicable fees will be agreed upon before work begins.



Communication



All day-to-day communication during employment will take place through 
.



You should be comfortable receiving instructions, asking questions and providing progress updates through 
.



Long-Term Opportunity and Bonuses



I'm looking to build a long-term team with reliable people who want to grow alongside the business.



Performance-based bonuses may be awarded for excellent work, consistently strong performance or particularly good business results. Bonuses are discretionary and are not guaranteed.



As the business grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibilities and higher earnings.

A brief introduction about yourself.



Your experience using CapCut.



Any experience sourcing clips or researching online content.

Your expected monthly salary.



Your weekly availability.



Your availability to start.



Confirmation that you're comfortable using PayPal and 
.
