Our assistant Stampy gives people creative designer superpowers, so anyone can send a card that looks like they tried harder, cared more, and nailed it. It is Christmas, our busiest season, and we need a video ad editor who can start right away and ship ads that sell, every working day.



This is an ads job. You make short 9:16 video ads for Meta and TikTok, built to drive purchases, working directly with our paid ads lead. It is not long-form YouTube, not sponsored influencer posts, and not a role where we teach you the tools. You need to be productive in week one.



What you'll make:



-2 to 3 finished ads per working day during peak season, 15 to 30 seconds each, 9:16 for Meta and TikTok.

-Story ads with real emotion: Christmas moments, family far away, the last-minute card panic, the card that makes someone tear up.

-Product ads built from real screen recordings of our card maker, showing the real steps and the finished card.

-Hook variations and cut-downs of winning ads so we can test fast.

-Sound design, music and voiceover on every ad: a clear sound in the first second, effects on the key moments, music that lifts at the payoff.



How we work (please read this twice):



1. Brief first. You build what the brief asks for. Have a better idea? Pitch it in writing and we may test it, but nothing outside the brief gets produced without sign-off.

2. Storyboard before you render. Every ad starts as a short storyboard with the script, shot list and the source of every shot (our footage, screen recordings or AI shots). We approve it, then you build.

3. Show work daily. Post a written standup every weekday morning and share drafts in progress. We would rather see a rough cut on day one than a finished ad on day four.

4. Flag blockers the same day. If a tool, file or login isn't working, tell us within a couple of hours. Silence is the one thing we can't work with.

5. Spend like it's your own money. AI renders are tested at low resolution first, costed before the final take, and logged.



The AI part:



We are an AI-first creative shop. You will generate shots and keyframes through APIs on company keys, using models such as Kling, Seedance, Flux and GPT Image on platforms such as fal, Replicate and OpenAI, and you will run our in-house Claude skills in the Claude desktop app. You must already be comfortable setting up API keys, keeping them secure, and estimating what a render will cost before you run it. If you have only used AI tools through app subscriptions and never through an API, this role is not the right fit.



Must have:



-A portfolio of paid social video ads you edited for Meta, TikTok or YouTube, not just reels or vlogs. A real portfolio site or ad reel. Bare Google Drive folders will not be reviewed.

-2+ years editing short-form ads for consumer, ecommerce or DTC brands.

-Fluency in Premiere Pro, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or similar for motion text.

-Hands-on AI video and image generation through APIs (fal, Replicate, OpenAI or similar).

-A real feel for hooks, pacing and sound. You know the first second d
 whether anyone keeps watching.

-Strong American pop-culture fluency and C1 English, written and spoken.

-Availability for our daily overlap: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern (10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time). The remaining hours are flexible.

-A computer that renders 1080p without struggling, stable internet, and a backup plan for brownouts.



Nice to have:



-Results you can point to: an ad you cut that scaled, or a hook test you won.

-Experience with Christmas, gifting, family or ecommerce brands.

-AI voiceover (ElevenLabs or similar) and music tools.



Who you work with: Our paid ads lead directs your day-to-day work and our founder gives final approval. Everything runs on written briefs in Slack.



How we start: Every hire starts with a short paid test at your hourly rate, with a time cap. You get a real brief, send back a storyboard and script for approval, then deliver one finished 15 to 20 second 9:16 ad that uses at least one AI shot generated through an API, with the render cost logged. Top candidates move to a paid trial. We hire on the work.



How to apply:



-Put the words STAMPY CUT at the top of your application. We skip applications without them.

-Your ad portfolio or reel link, plus 3 ads you edited, with the brand, the platform and what you did on each.

-The AI video and image models you have run through an API, which platform you ran them on, and roughly what a 5 second clip cost.

-Two or three sentences: you get a brief for three ads at 9:00 AM ET. What do you send us by 1:00 PM ET?

-Your hourly rate in USD and your earliest start date.

title: Patient Lead and Marketing Coordinator — U.S. Boutique Plastic Surgery Practice
description:
Aestira is a boutique plastic surgery and aesthetics practice based in Miami, Florida. We are a small, founder-led practice focused on thoughtful, personalized care, natural results, and an elevated patient experience.



We are looking for a highly reliable, articulate, detail-oriented person to join our team long term.

This is not a temporary freelance position, and we are not looking for someone who simply waits for tasks to be assigned.

We want someone who can learn how our practice works, communicate exceptionally well with patients, take ownership of recurring responsibilities, and gradually become a trusted member of the team.

We are willing to invest significant time in training the right person.

You do not need to know every system or skill on day one.



What matters most to us is:



- Experience with phone calls and outbound sales calls

- Excellent communication

- Strong judgment

- Reliability

- Attention to detail

- Organization

- Initiative

- Ability to learn

- Long-term fit



What You'll Do



1. Patient & Lead Communication

This is the most important part of the position.

You will help manage our incoming leads and patient communication throughout the workday.



Responsibilities include:



- Answering inbound patient and lead calls

- Calling new surgical and aesthetic leads every day

- Following up with prospective patients who have not responded

- Helping schedule consultations

- Confirming upcoming appointments

- Making routine patient follow-up calls when instructed

- Sending appropriate follow-up texts and
s

- Documenting conversations accurately

- Maintaining accurate lead status and notes

- Making sure prospective patients do not fall through the cracks



You will frequently speak directly with U.S. patients.



We are therefore looking for someone who speaks English clearly and naturally and has a warm, polished, confident, professional phone presence. Spanish speaking is recommended.

We want patients to feel that they are speaking with a thoughtful member of the Aestira team—not a scripted call center.



2. CRM & Administrative Operations



You will help keep our lead and patient workflows organized.

Responsibilities may include:



- Maintaining our GoHighLevel CRM

- Updating lead stages, notes, and follow-up tasks

- Monitoring leads that require follow-up

- Assisting with scheduling

- Confirming appointments

- Helping maintain organized contact records

- Following established SOPs

- Identifying incomplete or missed follow-up

- Helping improve workflows as you become familiar with the practice

- Creating or updating internal checklists and SOPs when appropriate



Over time, we want this person to take increasing ownership of routine day-to-day operational tasks.



3. Website & SEO Support



You will assist with ongoing website and search optimization work. This may include:

- Publishing and formatting website articles

- Updating existing website content

- Uploading and optimizing images

- Adding internal links

- Updating alt text

- Updating titles and meta descriptions

- Basic keyword research

- Following on-page SEO checklists

- Updating older pages and articles

- Researching potential content topics

- Monitoring basic website content needs

Experience with WordPress or SEO is helpful, but advanced SEO expertise is not required.

We are happy to train someone who is technically capable and detail-oriented.

Experience with tools such as WordPress, Bricks Builder, RankMath, Yoast, Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console is a plus.



4. Social Media & Content Support



You may help with:

- Responding appropriately to routine comments and DMs

- Engaging with relevant accounts



You will NOT be responsible for creating social media content, only to reply and engage other accounts.





Who We're Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:

- An excellent spoken English communicator

- A strong written English communicator

- Warm and comfortable speaking with patients by phone

- Highly organized

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Proactive without overstepping

- Comfortable learning new technology

- Able to follow detailed processes

- Able to work independently once trained

- Good at recognizing when to ask a question rather than guess

- Comfortable handling several different types of responsibilities

- Interested in building a long-term role rather than working on a short project

- Someone who takes pride in doing small things correctly and consistently



Relevant backgrounds may include:



- Healthcare virtual assistance

- Medical reception

- Patient coordination

- Medical administration

- Dental, dermatology, plastic surgery, or med-spa support

- Customer service

- Hospitality

- Digital marketing

- Social media management

- Content creation

- Administrative work combined with marketing experience



A healthcare degree or nursing background is welcome, but it is not required.

Excellent communication, judgment, reliability, and organization matter more to us than credentials alone.

Experience with any of the following is useful but not required:



- GoHighLevel

- Zoom Phone

- WordPress

- Meta Business Suite

- Instagram

- TikTok

- Google Workspace

- ChatGPT or similar AI tools

- SEO tools

-
 marketing platforms



Schedule



Initially, this will be part time, then this will become a full-time 40-hour/week position at the end of the trial month.

Most hours will be worked Monday through Saturday, during Miami / U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Because answering inbound calls and responding to new leads is a core part of this position, you must be consistently available during your scheduled U.S. business hours.



There will also be approximately 1–2 hours of work on Saturdays for items such as:

- Lead follow-up

- CRM cleanup

- Social media posting

- Content scheduling

- Inbox review

- Light administrative work



There is no regular Sunday requirement.

The remaining weekly hours will primarily fall Monday through Friday.



Equipment & Work Environment



You must have:

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Reliable computer

- Quality headset and microphone

- Quiet environment appropriate for patient calls

- Reliable smartphone if needed for authentication

- Backup internet connection strongly preferred

- Backup power solution strongly preferred



Compensation



$
/month, depending on experience, communication ability, and relevant skill set.



Exceptional candidates with strong U.S. healthcare experience, excellent phone communication, and useful digital marketing or content skills may be considered above this range.

We are not looking for the lowest-cost applicant. We are looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term part of the practice. Compensation can increase as responsibilities, capability, and contribution to Aestira grow.



Patient Privacy



Because Aestira is a healthcare practice, confidentiality is essential.

You will receive training on our privacy and security procedures and will be expected to follow them carefully.

Patient information must always be handled appropriately.

This is an administrative and operational position.

If a patient asks a question requiring medical judgment, you are expected to escalate it to the appropriate clinical team member rather than independently providing medical advice.



Why This Role May Be Different



Aestira is a small and growing practice. You will not be one person inside a large outsourced VA team. You will work closely with the founder/plastic surgeon and our patient coordinator and will have exposure to many parts of the business. As you become more capable and familiar with the practice, we want you to take increasing ownership of your responsibilities. We are specifically looking for someone who would like to stay with Aestira for years, not months.



We will invest in training you if you invest in learning the role.



How to Apply



Please submit an application containing all of the following.



1. Short Introduction

In 150 words or less, tell us:

- Why this specific position interests you

- Why you believe your experience is relevant

Please do not send a generic cover letter.



2. Video Introduction

Send a 60–90 second Loom or similar video introducing yourself. Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script.



3. Voice Recording

Send a separate 30–60 second voice recording.



Imagine that a patient named Sarah submitted an inquiry yesterday about scheduling a plastic surgery consultation.

Leave her a voi
.

We are evaluating:

- Warmth

- Clarity

- Confidence

- Professionalism

- Spoken English

- Spoken Spanish (if able)



We are not evaluating your knowledge of plastic surgery.



4. Resume / CV

Please attach or link your current resume.



5. Current Employment

Tell us:

- Whether you are currently employed

- Your current working hours

- Whether you currently work with other clients

- Approximately how many hours you work elsewhere each week

- Whether you can reliably work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



6. Compensation

Tell us your desired monthly compensation for a full-time 40-hour/week position.



7. Equipment

Please provide:

- Internet speed

- Computer specifications

- Headset/microphone

- Backup internet

- Backup power, if available



8. Relevant Experience

Briefly describe your experience, if any, with:

- U.S. healthcare

- Phone or customer service

- Patient scheduling or follow-up

- CRM systems

- WordPress or website management

- SEO

- Social media

- TikTok

- Instagram

You do not need experience in every category.



One Small Request

At the very end of your application, tell us:



What is one place in the world you would most like to visit, and why?



This helps us get to know you and confirms that you read the complete posting.



Application Questions

Please keep your answers concise and specific.

1. A prospective facelift patient submitted an inquiry yesterday. We sent two messages but have received no response. What would you do next?

2. A patient asks you whether swelling after her procedure is normal, but you are not certain whether what she is describing is medically concerning. How would you handle this?

3. You begin your shift and see:

- Three new leads waiting for calls

- Six Instagram messages

- A website article that should be published today

- A TikTok post with a several comments expressing interest

What would you prioritize first, and why?

4. Tell us about a recurring problem you noticed at a previous job. What did you do about it?

5. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. How did you discover it, and what did you do afterward?

6. Imagine you have been trained to perform a task one way, but you believe you have found a better way to do it. What would you do?

7. Tell us about a position where you stayed for a significant period of time. What made you stay?

8. Which part of this position would you be strongest at immediately? Which part would require the most training?

9. A potential patient says on the phone:

"I don't want to schedule anything yet. I just want to know how much a facelift costs."

How would you respond?



Applications that do not include the requested video and voice recording will not be considered.

title: Accounting Operations & Executive Support Associate
description:
Sterling Insurance Brokers Ltd.

Remote / Hybrid



About Sterling



Sterling Insurance Brokers Ltd. is a growing Canadian commercial insurance brokerage serving businesses across multiple industries. We pride ourselves on delivering responsive, professional service while maintaining strong operational discipline behind the scenes.



As we continue to grow, we are seeking two highly capable, organized, detail-oriented, and professional Accounting Operations & Executive Support Associates to support our finance, operations, and leadership teams.



This is a multifaceted role combining bookkeeping support, operational coordination, administrative support, brokerage assistance, and client-facing responsibilities.



?



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional bookkeeping-only role.



The successful candidate will support the day-to-day financial and operational workflows of the brokerage while also assisting senior management with administrative coordination, scheduling, communication management, and ad hoc business support tasks.



You will work closely with the Accounting Manager / Controller while also supporting senior leadership as operational priorities arise.



This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, adaptable, polished, proactive, and comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast-paced business environment.



?



Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Financial Operations



* Record daily financial transactions accurately and consistently

* Maintain organized and up-to-date accounting records

* Track accounts receivable and assist with collections follow-up

* Process accounts payable and prepare payment schedules

* Assist with client refund processing and payment documentation

* Support bank and account reconciliations

* Match financial records against internal systems and identify discrepancies

* Assist with month-end close support and reporting preparation



Administrative & Executive Support



* Monitor and assist in managing calendars, schedules, and appointments

* Support email monitoring, follow-up coordination, and administrative correspondence

* Assist with internal task coordination and workflow management

* Help ensure priorities are tracked and operational items are followed through

* Provide general executive and administrative support to senior management as required



Operations / Brokerage Support



* Support senior leadership with ad hoc brokerage operations tasks

* Assist with underwriting support tasks as required

* Help prepare documents, submissions, reports, presentations, and internal materials

* Support operational process execution across the business

* Maintain accurate documentation and records across systems

* Assist with special projects and strategic initiatives as required



Client Communication



* Take calls with clients and provide professional assistance where required

* Communicate clearly and professionally via phone and email

* Present information confidently and accurately

* Represent Sterling in a polished and professional manner



?



Qualifications



Required



* Minimum Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university (any discipline accepted)

* 1–3+ years of professional experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, operations, executive assistance, administrative coordination, or similar business support roles

* Experience working with CRM and/or ERP software platforms

* Candidates must clearly reference specific systems used in their resume and/or cover letter

* Strong working knowledge of:

 * Accounts Receivable

 * Accounts Payable

 * Basic reconciliations

 * Transaction processing

* Strong Excel / spreadsheet proficiency

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong presentation and interpersonal skills

* Professional phone presence and client communication ability

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

* Ability to manage multiple moving priorities effectively



Preferred / Asset



* Experience in an insurance brokerage, MGA, underwriting, financial services, or related industry

* Familiarity with Applied Epic or similar insurance management systems

* Experience supporting senior leadership or executives

* Experience in high-volume operational environments



?



What Success Looks Like



* Accurate bookkeeping and financial support

* Organized and responsive administrative execution

* Professional and polished client interactions

* Reliable support for leadership and operations

* Strong follow-through and task ownership

* Ability to adapt quickly as business needs evolve



?



Reporting Structure



This role will work under the supervision of the Accounting Manager / Controller, while also supporting senior leadership across the business as required.

title: Luxury vacation rental logo design
description:
Project Overview



Oklahoma Shores is an upscale hospitality brand managing a curated portfolio of 7 distinct waterfront properties across Eastern Oklahoma. Our collection ranges from luxury tiny cabins and a premium geodesic glamping dome tent on a 100-acre riverfront ranch to high-capacity lakefront retreat estates.

We are launching a premium direct-booking network and need a specialized Brand Identity Artist / VA to create our master logo and visual asset suite.



Visual Vibe & Guardrails



• The Aesthetic: Rustic Luxury, High-End Heritage Estate, Upscale Lodge.

• What to Avoid: Please do NOT submit concepts that are cold, sterile, hyper-modern, or abstract minimal. We want the brand to feel warm, deeply established, and rich with regional history. Avoid generic clip-art houses or basic wavy lines.



Detailed Design Brief



1. The Emblem (The Waterfront Heritage Crest):

We require a classic, elegant framed estate crest or heraldic badge using fine, whisper-thin vector line art. The crest must seamlessly weave together three specific motifs:

 • A classic rustic windmill (honoring our 100-acre Oklahoma ranch heritage).

 • Subtle rolling landscape/bluff curves (representing our position high on the Grand River bluffs).

 • Clean horizontal shoreline/water reflections at the base of the emblem.

2. Typography & Font Styling:

 • Primary Text ("OKLAHOMA"): A stately, high-character serif typeface that carries weight and history, preferably with subtle, clean chiseled edges.

 • Secondary Text ("SHORES"): A clean, sophisticated, modern sans-serif typeface with wide tracking (letter-spacing) sitting perfectly aligned beneath the primary text.

3. Color Palette: Organic, muted landscape tones. Iron charcoal/black, warm sand, and soft matte gold accents, with a brand accent of muted sage/moss green.



Required Deliverables



• Master Logo Lockup: Full brand mark containing the text layout and the crest together.

• Standalone Sub-Mark: The isolated line-art crest badge on its own (for watermarks, digital welcome books, and property merchandise like robes and signage).

• Complete Vector Source Files: Fully scalable, transparent formats including .SVG, .EPS, and high-resolution .PNG.

title: Backend developer
description:
Part-Time Backend Developer – AI SaaS, Authentication & Security



Company: FYAM  

Hours: 4–5 hours per week initially  

Contract: Freelance, part-time, with potential for ongoing work



 About the Project



FYAM is developing an AI-powered application designed to help registered managers and care providers automate administrative tasks, including care-plan creation, service-user feedback analysis and staff compliance tracking.



We have already built the initial user interface and five interconnected automation workflows. We have also documented our data structures and the intended functionality of each workflow.



Our next priority is to develop the backend infrastructure required to turn the existing application into a secure, multi-user SaaS product.



I am looking for a backend-focused developer to help implement the underlying infrastructure, connect the existing workflows and prepare the application for a controlled customer pilot.



Your Responsibilities



 1. Backend Development

- Review the existing codebase and understand the current application architecture.

- Implement and improve backend functionality using the existing technology stack.

- Connect the frontend to the database and backend APIs.

- Help integrate our existing automated workflows into a reliable application.

- Support PDF uploads, text extraction and processing for AI-assisted care-plan generation.



2. Authentication and User Management

- Implement secure user registration, login, logout and password reset.

- Support multiple care-provider organisations using the same application.

- Implement appropriate user roles and permissions.

- Ensure users can only access information belonging to their organisation and permitted role.



3. Database and Data Security

- Configure and maintain a suitable database.

- Implement appropriate database access policies and server-side authorisation.

- Apply encryption in transit and at rest using suitable managed services and configurations.

- Protect API keys, credentials and environment variables.

- Implement secure file storage, access restrictions and appropriate retention and deletion processes.

- Help establish backups and recovery procedures.



4. Testing and Deployment

- Test authentication, permissions and organisation-level data isolation.

- Test the complete workflow from PDF upload to generated care-plan draft.

- Identify and resolve backend bugs and integration issues.

- Assist with production deployment, logging and error monitoring.

- Document the setup so the application can be maintained and extended.



Required Skills



We are particularly interested in candidates with practical experience in:



- Backend web development and REST APIs.

- JavaScript or TypeScript, or the backend language used by our existing project.

- PostgreSQL, Supabase or a comparable database platform.

- Authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

- Secure file uploads and document processing.

- GitHub, debugging, testing and deployment.

- API integration and AI-powered applications.



Experience with Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL row-level security, cloud storage and managed hosting would be beneficial if compatible with the existing architecture.



The Ideal Candidate



- Can work with an existing Codex-generated codebase rather than starting from scratch.

- Understands the difference between frontend visibility and genuine backend security.

- Can explain technical decisions in straightforward language.

- Is comfortable working independently on small, clearly defined tasks.

- Takes confidentiality and sensitive care-sector information seriously.

- Is willing to document their work and communicate progress each week.



We do not expect one person to be an expert in every area. However, practical backend experience is essential, and experience with multi-user applications is particularly valuable.



Working Arrangement and Budget



This is a strictly part-time freelance engagement, not a full-time position.



- Approximately 4–5 hours per week.

- Flexible working arrangements with agreed weekly milestones.

- A small paid trial task before committing to ongoing work.



The initial milestone will be to review the existing application, identify the most important backend and security gaps, and provide a prioritised implementation plan.



Further work will focus on the highest-priority tasks within the agreed budget.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your relevant backend development experience.

2. Your GitHub profile or portfolio.

3. An example of an application where you implemented authentication and database access controls.

4. Your experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications and file uploads.

5. Your hourly rate and availability for 4–5 hours per week.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable working within our monthly budget.



Please begin your application with **SMART SUMMARISE** so we know you have read the full description.



We are looking for a dependable developer who can help us build on our existing work and move Smart Summarise towards a secure customer pilot.

title: Experienced Creative Strategist for a Beauty & Supplement E-Commerce
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong background in DTC/e-commerce, especially within beauty, skincare, and supplement brands.



This is a performance-focused role. We’re not only looking for someone who can create good-looking ads, but we want someone who understands what makes creatives spend, scale, and generate profitable ROAS.



What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Create video and static ad concepts for Meta.

- Write hooks, scripts, headlines, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

- Develop concepts for different personas and stages of awareness.

- Analyze Spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other creative performance metrics.

- Identify winning creatives and develop iterations to help them scale.

- Work closely with our media buyers, editors, and designers.

- Ensure ad messaging and creative angles align with our landing/product pages.

Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT: PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.

AD/CREATIVE

title: CRO & A/B Testing Specialist (E-commerce / DTC)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced CRO & A/B Testing Specialist to help us systematically improve the conversion rates of our DTC e-commerce stores.



You’ll be responsible for identifying conversion opportunities, developing testing hypotheses, launching A/B tests, analyzing results, and turning insights into actionable improvements across our landing pages, product pages, offers, bundles, and checkout funnel.



Key Responsibilities

Analyze website and funnel performance to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities.

Develop a structured CRO roadmap and A/B testing strategy.

Build, launch, and manage A/B tests using Intelligems or similar experimentation platforms.

Test elements such as:

Pricing and offers

Bundles and quantity breaks

Subscription vs. one-time purchase offers

Product page layouts

Headlines, copy, CTAs, and creative

Upsells and cross-sells

Landing page structures

Determine appropriate test duration, sample size, and statistical significance.

Analyze test results beyond just CVR, including AOV, RPV, revenue, subscription take rate, and profitability.

Document learnings and recommend which winning tests should be rolled out.

Work closely with our media buying, creative, and development teams.

Continuously develop new testing hypotheses based on customer behavior and performance data.



Requirements

Proven experience in CRO and A/B testing for DTC/e-commerce brands.

Hands-on experience with Intelligems or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Shopify conversion funnels.

Experience testing pricing, bundles, subscriptions, PDPs, and landing pages.

Strong analytical skills and understanding of statistical significance.

Comfortable interpreting data and translating it into clear actions.

Able to show examples of previous tests and measurable improvements.



To apply, please send us your portfolio so we can see your previous work, let us know the tools you used for testing, and let us know your rate.

title: Online Business Manager (OBM) – Operations & Growth | U.S. Life Insurance Agency
description:
Full-Time | Remote — Philippines | $1,200–$1,500 USD/month (depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities)





Are you the kind of person who sees what needs to be done—and makes it happen?



We're looking for an experienced, proactive, and highly resourceful Online Business Manager (OBM) to become the right hand to the founder of a growing U.S.-based life insurance agency.



This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions, checks tasks off a list, or needs to be told what to do next.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, takes initiative, solves problems, builds systems, and knows how to turn ideas into completed projects.



Someone who doesn't just identify problems but comes prepared with solutions.



Someone who genuinely wants to understand the business, become invested in its success, and play an important role in helping it grow.



If you're someone who enjoys creating order out of chaos, building processes, improving operations, and making life easier for a busy entrepreneur, we'd love to hear from you.

__________________







*ABOUT US*



Overflow Life & Legacy is a growing U.S.-based independent life insurance agency affiliated with Symmetry Financial Group.



We help families protect what matters most while building an expanding organization of insurance professionals and agency leaders.



Our agency is entering an important season of growth. We're expanding our recruiting efforts, developing new agents, strengthening our systems, and putting the infrastructure in place to support a much larger organization.



We've reached a point where the founder needs more than administrative assistance.



We need an experienced operational partner who can help turn vision into execution.



You'll work directly with the agency owner, helping manage the day-to-day operations while building systems that allow the business to grow more efficiently.



This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact—not simply maintain existing processes.

__________________





*WHAT YOU'LL OWN*



1. Business Operations & Executive Support



Become the founder's right hand in keeping the business organized, efficient, and moving forward.



You'll manage
 inboxes, coordinate communications and follow-ups, organize priorities, oversee administrative workflows, and make sure important responsibilities don't fall through the cracks.



Your job is to help the founder stay focused on the highest-value activities while ensuring day-to-day operations run smoothly.





2. Project Management & Implementation



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



The founder frequently develops new ideas, strategies, and initiatives to improve and grow the agency.



We need someone who can take those ideas, ask the right questions, develop an implementation plan, and drive projects through completion.



You'll establish timelines, organize tasks, manage deadlines, coordinate resources, and take responsibility for execution.



We don't want someone who simply tracks projects. We want someone who makes sure projects get finished.





3. Systems, Processes & Automation



You'll identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, create SOPs, organize business systems, and implement improvements that help us operate more effectively.



We're looking for someone who enjoys evaluating how things currently work and finding ways to make them better.



You'll work with tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and automation tools.



You don't need to know every platform we use, but you should be highly comfortable learning new systems and figuring out how to make them work together.





4. Recruiting & Agent Onboarding Operations



Recruiting and developing insurance agents is a major part of our growth strategy.



You'll help oversee the operational side of our recruiting pipeline, including candidate tracking, interview coordination, follow-up systems, licensing progress, onboarding, and new agent activation.



You'll also identify bottlenecks, improve processes, coordinate with recruiting partners, and help create systems that support a growing team.



You won't be responsible for personally conducting every interview or training agents to sell insurance. Your responsibility is to help ensure the operational systems supporting those activities are effective.





5. Business Reporting & Performance Dashboards



You'll create and maintain dashboards that give us visibility into recruiting, onboarding, agency performance, and other important business metrics.



But we don't just want someone who enters numbers into spreadsheets.



We want someone who can look at the information, recognize patterns, identify problems, and recommend improvements.





6. Marketing & Growth Coordination



You'll help coordinate marketing initiatives, content schedules, recruiting campaigns, and other growth-related projects.



This includes organizing deliverables, managing timelines, coordinating resources, and ensuring initiatives move from planning to execution.



You don't need to be a graphic designer, video editor, or marketing specialist. You do need to know how to organize and manage marketing projects successfully.

__________________







*WHAT OWNERSHIP LOOKS LIKE*



Let's say the founder shares an idea:



"We need a better onboarding process so new agents can get started faster and begin producing sooner."



A traditional assistant might wait for instructions on exactly what to do.



You would approach it differently.



You'd review the existing process, identify where agents are getting stuck, research potential improvements, and develop a proposed solution.



After discussing the plan with the founder, you'd take ownership of implementation, establish the necessary workflows, coordinate the moving parts, and monitor the results.



And once the project is completed, you'd look for ways to make it even better.



That's the mindset we're looking for.



You'll have the freedom to recommend improvements and make appropriate day-to-day operational decisions within agreed guidelines. Major strategic, financial, and business decisions will remain with the founder.

__________________







*WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR*



We're looking for someone with proven experience managing business operations and independently executing projects, ideally while working directly with an entrepreneur or business owner.



Required Qualifications:



-> 3–5+ years of relevant experience in online business management, operations management, or project management.



-> Demonstrated success taking projects from concept through implementation.



-> Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.



-> Experience developing systems, workflows, and SOPs.



-> Excellent organizational and project management skills.



-> Strong written and spoken English communication.



-> Experience managing competing priorities without constant supervision.



-> Confidence working with spreadsheets, CRMs, project management systems, and other online business tools.



-> The ability to understand how different parts of a business work together.



-> Comfort working in a growing business where not every process has already been documented.



-> Bonus Qualifications:



-> Experience working directly with U.S.-based business owners.



-> Experience managing operations in sales, recruiting, or service-based businesses.



-> Familiarity with Notion, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, and automation platforms.



-> Experience coordinating marketing initiatives or remote team members.



-> Experience creating and improving business reporting dashboards.



Previous life insurance experience is not required. We're far more interested in your operational capabilities, business judgment, and willingness to learn.

__________________







*THE KIND O PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE*



You're naturally curious about how businesses work.



You don't just complete assignments—you understand why they matter.



You ask thoughtful questions, but you're also resourceful enough to research solutions independently.



You're comfortable respectfully challenging an idea when you see a better way to accomplish the objective.



You communicate proactively, take accountability seriously, and follow through on commitments.



You can distinguish between what's urgent and what's important, and you know how to prioritize when several things need attention.



Most importantly, you take pride in making the business better because you were part of it.



If you prefer a role where every task is clearly outlined and someone else makes all the decisions, this probably isn't the best fit.



But if you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and contributing to the growth of a business, this could be an excellent opportunity.

__________________







*WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS*



First 30 Days — Learn & Take Ownership

Understand our business, tools, people, and priorities. Take ownership of recurring operational responsibilities, organize existing projects, and identify the most important areas for improvement.



Days 31–60 — Build & Implement

Begin implementing improved workflows, establish reliable reporting, strengthen recruiting and onboarding systems, and independently manage agreed projects.



Days 61–90 — Lead & Improve

Demonstrate consistent ownership of day-to-day operations, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, deliver projects with minimal oversight, and provide actionable recommendations that support our continued growth.



Our goal is to develop a relationship where the founder can confidently delegate an operational objective and trust that it will be thoughtfully managed through completion.

__________________







*COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY*



Salary: $1,200–$1,500 USD per month, based on qualifications and experience.



Position: Full-time, 40 hours per week.



Location: Remote, Philippines.



Schedule: Consistent daily availability overlapping with U.S. Eastern Time is required.



Evaluation: Initial 90-day performance review.



Growth: Long-term opportunity to grow into a key operational leadership role within the agency.



We're looking for someone interested in a long-term relationship with a growing company where their work, ideas, and contributions genuinely matter.

__________________







*HOW TO APPLY*



We're excited to learn more about you! We've intentionally kept our application process simple because we respect your time.



Please include the following:



1. Your résumé and cover letter



Share your relevant experience, including any operations management, project management, or business systems work.



2. A brief video introduction (2–3 minutes)



Using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform, share a link to a short video introducing yourself and answering these two questions:



What interests you most about this opportunity, and why do you believe you'd be a great fit?



Tell us about a project or process improvement you personally took ownership of. What did you do, and what was the outcome?



No special editing or professional production is necessary. We're simply interested in getting to know you and hearing about your experience.

IMPORTANT: APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



3. Please confirm your availability for full-time work, your ability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time, and your expected monthly compensation.



Selected candidates will be invited to an interview, with finalists potentially completing a short, paid practical assessment.



We value genuine experience, independent thinking, and a desire to contribute. We're looking forward to learning what makes you uniquely qualified for this opportunity.

__________________







*WHY JOIN US*



This is more than an opportunity to manage administrative tasks.



It's an opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur, contribute your ideas, help shape business operations, and play a meaningful role in growing an organization.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a trusted partner in execution—someone who takes ownership, embraces challenges, and enjoys seeing the results of their work.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to learning more about you and what you can bring to Overflow Life & Legacy.

title: Doctor Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Physician to help manage patient charts, review medical records, and ensure patients are fully prepared for their upcoming procedures.



The ideal candidate will have a strong medical background, excellent attention to detail, and experience reviewing medical records, laboratory results, and diagnostic imaging reports.

Your primary responsibility will be to review every patient's chart to ensure all required documentation, testing, and pre-procedure requirements are completed and accurate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Chart Review & Quality Assurance



Review patient charts thoroughly to ensure all required information is present and accurate.

Verify that patients have completed the appropriate laboratory testing and X-rays for their scheduled procedures.

Review lab results, including CBC, BMP, PT/INR, and kidney function tests, according to established protocols.

Verify that X-rays and other diagnostic imaging reports are available and within the required timeframes.

Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete medical records.

Review medical histories, medications, allergies, and relevant clinical documentation.

Flag abnormal results or potential concerns for review by the physician or licensed clinical team.

Ensure every patient chart is complete and ready for physician review before the scheduled procedure.



2. Patient Communication & Follow-Up



Contact patients to confirm that required laboratory testing and imaging have been completed.

Notify patients when their pre-procedure requirements have been completed and reviewed by the appropriate clinical team.

Follow up with patients who have missing laboratory results, X-rays, or medical documentation.

Assist patients with obtaining outstanding records and completing required testing.

Answer general questions about appointment preparation and scheduling.

Escalate medical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare professional.



3. Procedure Readiness & Scheduling Support



Review upcoming procedure schedules to ensure patients are prepared.

Maintain an organized tracking system for patients with completed versus outstanding requirements.

Coordinate with physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, and scheduling staff.

Identify potential issues that could delay or cancel a procedure.

Provide daily updates on patient readiness and outstanding tasks.



Qualifications

Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Scribe, or Clinical Coordinator.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, laboratory testing, and medical documentation.

Experience reviewing patient charts and working with electronic medical records (EMRs).

Ability to identify missing documentation and recognize results that require clinical escalation.

Excellent communication skills and professional phone etiquette.

Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of patient charts.

Experience in interventional radiology, vascular medicine, or outpatient procedures is a plus.

Familiarity with HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is extremely detail-oriented, proactive, and dependable. This person should take ownership of ensuring that every patient's chart is thoroughly reviewed and that nothing important is overlooked before a procedure.



Our goal is to minimize cancellations, improve patient safety, and ensure every patient is fully prepared before arriving at our facilities.



Important: This is a non-licensed administrative and clinical support role. Final medical clearance, interpretation of clinical findings, and decisions about whether a patient can proceed with a procedure must be made by the appropriate licensed medical professional.

title: Phone-First Claims Assistant – Insurance Claims Firm (US Eastern Hours)
description:
HOURS: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday–Friday (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time)



ABOUT US

Accurate Insurance Consulting, a Cóir Risk Advisory company, is a licensed public adjusting firm. We represent homeowners and businesses in property insurance claims against their insurance companies in Virginia, Maryland, DC, Delaware, New Jersey and West Virginia. We're a small, tight team, and this role will be the voice of our office.



THE ROLE

Phones come first. You'll handle our calls with insurance carriers, clients and contractors, and between calls you'll support our claims team. Some carrier calls take five minutes and some sit on hold for an hour, so patience and persistence matter more than speed.



PHONE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Call insurance carriers for claim status, adjuster contact details, payment status and document requests

- Help file new claims with carriers by phone

- Answer and return client calls: updates, collecting documents and signatures, scheduling

- Coordinate inspection dates with contractors and carrier adjusters

- Answer incoming calls on our GoTo phone system and transfer calls to our licensed adjuster when needed



CLAIMS SUPPORT BETWEEN CALLS

- Log every call in our claims software (ClaimWizard), with clear, accurate notes

- Follow up on outstanding documents from clients and carriers

- Manage inspection and appointment scheduling

- Prepare file notes and summaries for the adjuster



IMPORTANT: This is an administrative role. You will not negotiate claims, interpret insurance policies or give advice to clients. Those go to our licensed adjuster, and knowing when to hand a call off is part of the job.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation. US callers must understand you easily.

- At least 1 year of phone-based work with US callers (call center, customer service, insurance or medical offices preferred)

- Comfortable making outbound calls and holding firm, politely, with large companies

- Strong written English for call notes

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quality USB headset and backup power/internet for brownouts

- Available for the full US Eastern shift



NICE TO HAVE

- US insurance experience, especially property claims

- Experience with ClaimWizard, GoTo or similar CRM/phone systems



HOW TO APPLY

1. Put "Carrier Call" in your subject line. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

2. Attach a voice recording (1–2 minutes) of yourself introducing yourself, then reading this as if calling an insurance company:

"Good afternoon, my name is [your name], calling from Accurate Insurance Consulting on behalf of our client. I'm following up on the status of their claim and would like to confirm whether the adjuster has received the documents we sent last week."

3. Tell us about a difficult phone call you handled and how it ended.

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Job Management (Katipolt)

Support quoting in the platform

Assist with materials coordination, including checking supplier deliveries and confirming gear is ready for upcoming jobs



Process Documentation



Document new workflows and processes as they’re refined and established — building the SOP library directly off live processes

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)

 and

Business Development & Lead Pipeline

 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Manage the Asana task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Participate in regular video calls, including impromptu calls while a director is on the road

Experience



Strong general business administration or EA background, with trades or construction industry exposure strongly preferred

Experience with business process documentation or SOP creation, ideally including breaking tasks into responsibility, cadence and time-per-task

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

Experience drafting invoices, supporting quoting processes, or managing job administration in a service business



Technical Proficiency (Core, Non-Negotiable)



Asana: experience or strong ability to set up and manage task boards, project pipelines and linked SOPs

Microsoft 365/Teams: comfortable with Outlook
, Teams video and associated tools

Confident, fast learner on job management or trades platforms

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT): genuine, proactive curiosity, not just baseline familiarity — actively pushes their own use of these tools rather than waiting to be shown

Strong written English for professional, client-facing communications



Technical Proficiency (Nice-to-Have)



Instagram and
 scheduling and 
 via Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn page-building experience from a low base

WordPress: minor content and photo updates; SEO/landing-page skills are a bonus

Xero experience is valuable but not mandatory for day one



Communication & Independence



Proactive, not passive — raises questions, confirms understanding, and flags issues before they become problems

Earns trust quickly with busy, selective directors

Confident enough to suggest a better way and push back constructively

Comfortable on frequent video calls, including impromptu check-ins



Organisational Skills



Manages multiple concurrent workstreams (admin, job platform,
 follow-up, SOP creation, light social scheduling) without dropping the ball

Strong self-directed time management within a 4-hour daily shift

Captures tasks, ideas and follow-up items in Asana unprompted



Non-Negotiables

Growth-oriented environment with a clear path to more responsibility as the role and the business evolve

title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst
description:
Job Title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst



Type: Full-time · Remote · ~35-40 hours/week



Compensation: $605 –$735 USD/month (based on experience and skills)



About PyQuant

PyQuant is a financial research platform that helps individual investors evaluate public companies through fundamental financial analysis and financial statement breakdown. We focus on reported financials, long-term trends, and clear, explainable metric. No market hype or pricing involved.



We're looking for a detail-oriented researcher who understands company financials and can turn that research into useful, engaging content for retail investors, organically growing our audience.



The Role

This is a finance-first research and content role - not a social media scheduling or marketing analytics position. You will:



- Investigate public companies and verify financial claims against primary sources (yahoo finance, reuters, morning star, google finance, bloomberg, etc.)

- Turn your findings into accessible content for retail investors

- Help identify investor communities, creators, and organic channels to reach people interested in fundamental investing



What We're Looking For

1. Financial Statement Analysis:

- Comfortable reading income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

- Able to interpret revenue growth, profit margins, earnings, debt, liquidity, cash generation, and valuation metrics

- Has identified financial statement trends YoY and QoQ using Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)

- Can identify meaningful multi-year financial trends and explain why a metric matters (and its limitations)



2. SEC Filing Research

- Experience researching companies via 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, and investor relations materials

- Able to locate and verify figures against original sources

- Understands reporting periods, accounting terminology, and accurate citations



3. Financial Writing & Content Development

- Strong written English; can explain complex financial concepts clearly to a retail audience

- Can turn research into company breakdowns, metric explainers, comparisons, social posts, and article outlines

- Distinguishes reported facts from interpretation and opinion



4. Organic Marketing & Audience Research

- Interested in value/fundamental investing and the retail investor community

- Can research relevant forums, newsletters, creators, and content platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads)

- Able to track engagement, referral traffic, and signups where measurable



Preferred Background

Especially value candidates with education/experience in:

- Finance, accounting, equity research, or investment research

- Financial journalism or writing about public companies

- Financial modeling, spreadsheet analysis, or company valuation

- SEO, content strategy, or social media marketing

- Experience with SEC EDGAR, spreadsheets, Canva, and scheduling tools is a plus, but financial research ability and writing quality matter more than any specific tool.



How to Apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction with your relevant experience and resume

- Your background in finance, accounting, research, or writing

- A writing sample (and an example of financial analysis, if available)

- A short explanation of how you'd research a public company using its latest annual report



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid financial research and writing exercise.

You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.

title: Wedding Video Editor
description:
PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU EDIT WITH FINAL CUT PRO.

Are you a talented wedding video editor with an eye for storytelling and a passion for editing? We’re looking for a skilled freelance editor to join our team and match our cinematic, timeless editing style.



**Who We Are**



We are an Australian wedding film company capturing love stories. We’re expanding our video offerings and looking for an editor who can create meaningful wedding films that match our brand’s aesthetic.

**What You’ll Do**

- Create full ceremony and speeches edits

- Sync audio, clean up sound, and balance dialogue and music to elevate the finished film.

- Edit in **Final Cut Pro using proxies** from Sony S-Log3 footage.

- Follow our brand guidelines and reference films to consistently match our style.

- Handle revisions based on feedback.

- Deliver finished exports and XML for relinking to our original footage.



**What We’re Looking For**



✅ **Experience:** At least two years of wedding video editing experience, including cinematic highlight films, short-form teasers, ceremony and speeches edits.



✅ **Software proficiency:** You **must work in Final Cut Pro** and be comfortable editing with proxies.



✅ **Storytelling:** Strong instincts for pacing, music, and emotional moments, with the ability to create an engaging 5–8 minute film.



✅ **Style matching:** The ability to follow our established editing style and reference videos.



✅ **Attention to detail:** Strong shot choice, shot matching, audio editing, and sound design skills.



✅ **Reliability:** Clear English communication, the ability to meet agreed deadlines, and a willingness to take feedback.



✅ **Reliable internet:** A high-speed internet connection capable of handling large wedding footage downloads and project uploads.



**Compensation & Work Details**



- **AUD $200–$350 per project**, with the rate agreed before editing begins based on the deliverables and responsibilities.

- Flexible, remote freelance work.

- Turnaround times agreed before each project begins.

- Opportunity for regular ongoing projects as we build a long-term working relationship.

- PayPal Payment



**Long-Term Opportunity**



Our goal is to find someone who can become a trusted part of our post-production workflow and a long-term member of the team. We’re looking for someone open-minded, eager to learn, and excited to grow as part of our team.



**Interested?**



If this opportunity sounds like a great fit for you, please complete our application.



To show us you’ve read the full job posting, include the word “FINAL CUT” at the beginning of your application. Applications that do not include 'FINAL CUT' will not be considered.



In your application, please include:



1. A brief introduction and an overview of your wedding video editing experience.

2. Links to 2–3 complete wedding highlight films you personally edited, ideally 5–8 minutes long.

3. A link to your portfolio

4. Confirmation that you use **Final Cut Pro** and have experience working with proxies.

5. Your **rates in AUD** for a highlight film, ceremony edit, and speeches edit. Please specify how many revision rounds are included.

6. Your typical turnaround time, current availability, and how many wedding projects you can take on per month.



We can’t wait to see your work! 🎞️

- Willingness to upload every call recording to our shared folder after each shift, and to log every call in a Google Sheet

Experience selling to trades, construction or commercial services.



WE PROVIDE

The script, the lead list and the offer details.

title: Supply Chain Manager for Fashion E-commerce Store
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager for a growing fashion e-commerce / fashion dropshipping store. We are looking for someone who works accurately, takes responsibility, and makes sure orders are properly followed up after purchase: from fulfilment and tracking all the way to final delivery to the customer.



You will start with approximately 1 hour of work per day. As the store continues to grow and the number of orders increases, the workload and number of hours will also increase. Starting rate: $3 per hour.



🧠 Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience with supply chain, logistics, or order management within e-commerce or dropshipping

• Preferably has experience within fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping

• Has experience with ParcelPanel

• Understands fulfilment, tracking, and international shipping

• Has experience communicating directly with suppliers

• Works very accurately and is highly organised

• Can independently identify and solve problems

• Preferably identifies problems before they become bigger issues

• Takes responsibility for their work

• Speaks and writes English well

• Is reliable and consistently available

• Learns quickly

• Thinks proactively about how processes can be improved

• Is looking for a long-term position

Experience within fashion dropshipping is strongly preferred.



📦 Your Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the daily monitoring and follow-up of the supply chain of our fashion store. Your responsibilities include:

• Checking ParcelPanel daily

• Checking whether orders have correct tracking information

• Checking whether orders have actually been shipped

• Monitoring tracking statuses

• Checking whether shipments continue to move normally

• Making sure customers ultimately receive their orders

• Following up on open and delayed shipments

• Identifying unshipped orders and discussing them with the supplier

• Investigating missing tracking information

• Identifying incorrect or incomplete addresses

• Following up on missing house numbers and other address issues

• Checking and following up on Pick Up orders

• Identifying and following up on Return to Sender orders

• Identifying and following up on Lost in Transit orders

• Identifying and following up on Out of Stock orders

• Monitoring Shipment Delays daily

• Checking whether tracking statuses have changed

• Communicating directly with the supplier when there is an issue with an order or shipment

• Keeping Supply Chain Management Sheets accurate and up to date

• Recording issues in the correct tab

• Closing resolved issues correctly

• Identifying recurring shipping or fulfilment problems

• Reporting clearly each day which issues are still open and which have been resolved



🔍 Situations You Should Be Able to Recognise

You should be comfortable working with tracking and order statuses such as: Delivered, In Transit, Pick Up, Return to Sender, Bad Address, Address Error, Refused, Not Picked Up, Info Received, Unfulfilled, Out of Stock, Lost in Transit, Shipment Delay.



It is important that you understand which orders only need continued monitoring and which orders require action. We are not looking for someone who simply says: "This order has a problem." We want someone who immediately investigates: "Why did this happen, what is the current status, and what needs to be done to resolve it?"



🛠 Tools You Will Work With

Experience with the following tools is an advantage: ParcelPanel, Shopify, Supply Chain Management Sheets, 17Track, Yun Express, ParcelsApp, Slack, ReAmaze / Gorgias, Google Sheets.



🤝 Who Will You Work With?

You will work closely with:

• The store owner

• Our supplier

• Our Customer Support Representative

When Customer Support identifies a problem with an order, you should be able to investigate what is happening with the order or shipment. Likewise, it is important that you inform Customer Support in time when something is happening with an order and the customer needs to be updated. Good and fast communication between you, the supplier, and Customer Support is therefore very important.



📊 What Do We Expect From You?

title: Shopify Customer Support | Fashion & Dropshipping | 2–4 Hours Daily
description:
Shopify Customer Support | Fashion & Dropshipping | 2–4 Hours Daily



We're looking for an experienced customer support freelancer to manage
 support for our Shopify fashion store.



You'll handle customer enquiries and complaints, keep our inbox organised and take ownership of each case through to resolution. We value warm, personal communication, accurate information and reliable follow-up.



Our priorities are customer satisfaction, preventing avoidable escalations and chargebacks, and reducing unnecessary return and refund costs through fair, appropriate solutions.



About the role:



* Fully remote, with the intention of building a long-term collaboration.

* Working days: seven days a week, Monday to Sunday, including weekends.

* Workload: 2–4 hours per day, totalling 14–28 hours per week.

* Hourly rate: US$3.

* Exact working times and daily inbox coverage will be agreed before starting.



Your responsibilities:



* Respond to customer
s about products, sizing, orders, delivery and tracking in clear, natural English.

* Handle delayed or missing orders, address issues, cancellation requests, order changes and out-of-stock situations.

* Resolve complaints about fit, quality, damaged items and incorrect products.

* Review Shopify order details, tracking information and previous correspondence before replying. Request relevant additional information or photos when needed.

* Offer and process approved replacements, store credit, partial refunds and full refunds in line with our procedures, your authorisation limits and applicable customer rights.

* Adapt our
 templates to each customer's situation, concerns and tone.

* Follow up with the relevant supplier or team member on order-related issues and keep customers informed until their cases are resolved.

* Keep open cases organised, with a clear next action and follow-up date.

* Accurately record complaint reasons, products, ticket references, offers, agreed solutions and refund amounts.

* Prepare a weekly summary of recurring product issues, including products receiving two or more complaints within seven days and the associated refund amounts.

* Promptly escalate disputes, chargeback notifications, serious complaints and cases outside your authority to the owner.



What we're looking for:



* Proven customer support experience with e-commerce dropshipping stores. Direct dropshipping experience is required.

* Practical Shopify experience, including reviewing orders and processing authorised changes and refunds.

* Excellent written English and a friendly, empathetic and professional communication style.

* Experience handling return requests, sizing complaints, shipping delays and frustrated customers.

* Sound judgement when choosing an appropriate solution or d
 when to escalate.

* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

* Experience using Google Sheets or Excel for accurate record keeping.

* A reliable computer and internet connection.

* Consistent availability every day, including weekends.



Experience with fashion stores and Parcel Panel is a plus.



We provide clear procedures,
 templates, onboarding and direct communication with the owner. We welcome practical suggestions for improving our customer service and are looking for someone we can build a lasting working relationship with.



Success in this role means providing accurate, helpful replies, meeting agreed response times, following cases through to resolution, maintaining complete records and identifying recurring problems early. Customer satisfaction and sound judgement matter alongside refund and escalation rates.



To apply, please introduce yourself briefly and answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have providing customer support for Shopify dropshipping stores? Include the types of products and the average number of customer enquiries you handled each day.

2. Describe a difficult return, sizing or quality complaint you personally resolved. What did you do, and what was the outcome?

3. How do you organise unresolved cases, follow up with suppliers and ensure customers receive updates?

4. Which tools have you used for
 support and reporting? Which performance metrics did you track?

- Handle daily creative production for 5–6 product funnels.
