title: Editorial / Educational DOCX Template Designer
description:
I am looking for an experienced editorial / educational document designer to create the universal lesson-packet design system for AnyText, an AI-assisted platform for adult ESL teachers.



PROJECT:

$300 fixed-price project. Some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with highly relevant experience.



AnyText takes an authentic article or transcript, adapts it to an adult ESL proficiency level, generates coordinated instructional activities, and exports the finished lesson as an editable Microsoft Word DOCX.



This is NOT simply a beautification project.



I need a professional, reusable document-design system that can eventually be implemented programmatically by my developer.



The template must work with VARIABLE CONTENT.



For example:

- A reading may be 1, 2, or 3+ pages

- Titles and questions may vary in length

- Activities may be included or omitted

- Sections may contain different numbers of items

- Images may be present or absent

- Teachers may edit the DOCX after export



The design therefore must reflow gracefully. I am not looking for one beautiful static mockup that only works with one sample lesson.



My developer will handle the DOCX programming. You will design the visual system and provide clear specifications he can implement.



DESIGN DIRECTION:



Adult-accessible editorial design.



Professional, scholarly, warm, calm, readable, restrained, and appropriate for adult learners.



Visual inspiration includes:

- The forest-moon atmosphere of Endor from Star Wars

- University libraries and reading rooms

- Independent bookstores

- Forest-facing study spaces

- The warmth and craftsmanship of older Starbucks interiors

- Oxford University Press

- Cambridge University Press

- The New York Times

- The Economist

- National Geographic



These are inspiration references only. I do not want literal Star Wars imagery, trees, fake wood, coffee-shop graphics, or a fake newspaper design.



The established AnyText palette is:



Deep Forest Green — #183F36

Dark Green-Black — #1F2B27

Charcoal — #303633

Mushroom Taupe — #A79D90

Warm Stone — #D8D1C6

Parchment — #F2EDE3

Paper White — #FCFBF8

Bronze / Umber — #8B6B50



I am NOT looking for a new color palette.



The final document must also remain professional when printed or photocopied in black and white.



SECTIONS TO DESIGN INCLUDE:



- Article title and metadata

- Images

- Contextual Introduction

- Key Concepts

- Warm-Up

- Main Reading

- Vocabulary Matching

- Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank

- Multiple Choice

- True / False

- Short Answer

- Discussion

- Pair Work

- Mingle

- Answer Key

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering



Each activity should belong to one unified visual system while still supporting its instructional purpose.



For example:

- Reading should feel like a professionally published educational reader

- Short Answer needs appropriate writing space

- Discussion should feel spacious and reflective

- Pair Work should make roles immediately understandable

- Mingle should support printable cut-apart strips/cards

- Answer Key should be compact and easy for teachers to scan



The final specification should define:



- Exact fonts

- Font sizes and weights

- Heading hierarchy

- Reading-body typography

- Directions and question styles

- Metadata treatment

- Line and paragraph spacing

- Margins

- Tables

- Borders

- Answer spaces

- Image placement and sizing

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering

- Page-break behavior

- Color usage

- Black-and-white behavior

- Rules for variable-length content



EDITABLE DOCX IS IMPORTANT:



Teachers will be able to rewrite questions, add notes, delete material, and otherwise edit the exported Word document.



The design therefore needs a strong underlying style system rather than fragile manual formatting.



ORIGINAL HUMAN DESIGN WORK REQUIRED:



I already use AI extensively to create educational resources and to develop AnyText. I am not hiring someone because I need another person to generate educational materials with AI.



I am hiring for professional HUMAN editorial and educational design judgment.



Please do not submit AI-generated workbook mockups or AI-generated template images that cannot function as a real editable document system.



I have worked with textbooks and instructional materials for many years and am specifically looking for someone with real experience in typography, page composition, long-form layout, educational publishing, or book/workbook design.



IDEAL EXPERIENCE:



- Editorial design

- Book / textbook / workbook layout

- Educational publishing

- Adobe InDesign

- Typesetting

- Master pages

- Paragraph / character / object styles

- Print production

- Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

- Dynamic or variable-content documents



I will provide:

- The existing AnyText logo

- The established visual direction

- The established color palette

- Several real AnyText-generated lesson packets



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:

1. A short introduction

2. 3–5 highly relevant portfolio samples

3. Any book, textbook, workbook, educational, editorial, report, or long-form layout examples

4. Any experience with Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

5. Any experience designing for variable or dynamically generated content

6. Your project estimate and turnaround time

7. One relevant portfolio piece and three design decisions you personally made on that project and why



Please begin your application with:



FOREST READER



FINAL STANDARD:



Whether an AnyText packet is 4 pages or 14 pages, a teacher should be able to download it, make small edits, print it, staple it, and hand it to an adult ESL class—and it should still look like it came from a professional educational publisher.

title: Short Form Video Editor (Reels / TikToks) — Content Agency
description:
About us:

We’re a content agency that produces short form video for business owners — scroll stopping Reels and TikToks that get our clients real results, not just views. We shoot the raw footage; you turn it into finished, ready to post content. This is a long-term role with real room to grow.



What you’ll be doing:



Editing vertical short form videos (15–60 sec) from our raw footage — Reels, TikToks, Shorts



Creating on-screen visuals and animations that illustrate what the speaker is talking about — if a client explains a point, you bring it to life on screen with graphics, text, and visual elements



Clean animated captions/subtitles, music, sound effects, color, and our branding



Sourcing your own B-roll and stock footage — pulling visuals from the client’s website, Google, and stock libraries to make the edit stronger (you don’t just wait for footage, you find what the video needs)



Cutting for retention — strong hook in the first 2 seconds, tight pacing, a CTA on every video

Occasionally some long-form editing (rare, but it comes up)



Following a simple brief for each client (we give you the hook, the vibe, the CTA)

Delivering batches consistently and on time





What I’m looking for (read carefully):



Consistency — the same high quality on video #1 and video #30. This matters most.

Communication — you reply, you ask when unclear, you update me. I will not chase you.

Strong English — you clearly understand direction and communicate back without confusion.

Strong visual animation + text skills — this is core, not a bonus. You can make on screen graphics that explain a point, not just slap captions on.

Resourcefulness — you can go find B-roll and stock footage on your own to elevate a video.

Software: strong in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a big plus). CapCut is okay only if your output genuinely looks high-quality — but I lean toward editors working in Adobe or DaVinci.

A real eye for what’s working on IG/TikTok right now — pacing, transitions, text styling

Handles volume (~30+ videos/month per client) without quality slipping

Reliable internet and your own editing setup





Logistics — read this, because it matters:



- Base rate: $6.50/hr, part time to start, flexible hours based on workload



- Commission & bonuses — and they come FAST: when its a last minute or important booking and i need an edit turned around quick, the editor who jumps on it and communicates gets paid extra — fast. This isn’t some far off reward you wait months for. Show up when it counts and the extra money comes quick.



- There is no ceiling on this role. I mean that. If you’re consistent and crushing it, I will take care of you above and beyond — more hours, more pay, more bonuses, and a real spot on a growing team. The right editor grows with this agency, not under it.



- Most of the specifics (workflow, growth path, how we’ll work together) we’ll cover on a call — this post is step one.





How to apply — follow these exactly (this is part of the test):



1. Start your message with the word “GROWTH” so I know you read the whole post.

2. Send 2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited (links).

3. In one or two sentences, tell me what makes a short-form video keep someone watching.

4. Best contact information



Applications that don’t follow all three steps won’t be considered.

title: Hiring Facebook Ads Static Designer (Ecommerce/DTC) – Long-Term Opportunity!
description:
Hiring
 Ads Static Designer (Ecommerce/DTC) – Long-Term Opportunity!



Mivourr is looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to join our team! You will be responsible for designing high-converting static ads at volume for our paid marketing channels, with a big focus on Meta.



We are looking to hire someone with 2+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience designing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience in health, beauty or wellness brands.



Who are we?

At Mivourr, we are dedicated to improving women’s lives by tackling a problem that’s rarely talked about: vaginal dryness and painful intimacy. Our hero product, vGlow, is an intimate red light therapy device that helps women feel comfortable and confident again. Since our launch, we have grown rapidly through performance marketing, selling worldwide with most customers in the US, Australia, UK and Canada. We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous growth, and we’re excited to bring on a graphic designer to play a pivotal role in scaling our creative output even further.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values: “work smart”, “overdeliver”, “speed is king” and “better everyday”. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.



If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a huge role in scaling it. Drive results with a small team of passionate, smart & hardworking people. Work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance, then you have come to the right place.



Key Objectives:

- Research winning static ads in our market (Meta Ad Library, competitors) and recreate and improve them for our brand

- Turn ad concepts, copy and product photos into scroll-stopping static ads for Meta

- Expand our proven static concepts into new angles, formats and visual styles to keep testing fresh

- Work closely with the founder to keep a consistent look across all creatives

- Drive measurable improvements in core ad metrics (CTR, CPA) using Meta performance data to guide every new design



Requirements:

- Fully remote, with reliable internet

- Fluent in English, with some daily overlap with European time zones

- Direct Response Expertise: 2+ years designing performance static ads for ecommerce/dropshipping brands or at a creative agency is a must

- Tools: Proficiency in Photoshop and/or Figma, plus AI image tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT or similar

- Strong eye for ad formats that convert: before/after, testimonials, us vs. them, listicles, native-style and social proof ads

- Solid copy sense: you know how to make a headline pop and keep text short and readable on mobile

- Ability to create product mockups and lifestyle visuals when we don’t have the right photo

- Fast and organized: you can keep quality high while working at volume under tight deadlines

- You take feedback well and turn it around quickly, without ego

- Comfortable working with women’s health and intimacy topics in a tasteful, educational way

- Excellent cultural fit as per our values above



Accountabilities:

- Produce a high volume of static ads every week using AI tools, mixing two types of work:

    - Competitor ad adaptations: recreate proven static ads from our swipe library for our product

    - New concepts: design original static ads to test new angles, with multiple variations each (usually different headlines or visuals)

- Use AI to speed up production without sacrificing quality: every ad must look polished, on-brand and ready to launch

- Export every ad in the right size (1:1, 4:5 or 9:16) with our naming convention, ready to launch

- Retouch and prepare product photos and visuals for ads, landing pages and
 when needed

- Keep our design files and brand assets organized in a shared library

- Turn around feedback and revisions within 24 hours



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.



Initial screening of your portfolio, then a trial project where you’ll design a set of test static ads for our product, and a final interview with the founder to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8-10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!



To apply, send your portfolio with as many static ads as possible that you’ve designed, ideally from the last 6 months (performance data is a big plus), and start your application with the word “Wizard” so we know you read the full post (ONLY applications with a strong ecommerce ads portfolio will be accepted).



Salary Expectation:

USD $1500 to $2500 per month + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)
description:
Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote, Philippines | Long-Term Career Opportunity

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for meetings with our U.S. team



About Our Company



Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online merchandise stores.



We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.



We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger foundation for continued growth.



About the Opportunity



Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.



We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and continuously improve our processes.



The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.



We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.



We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.



As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems, procedures, and team that support a much larger business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting & Financial Operations



• Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

• Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Oversee 
, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions from our various sales platforms.

• Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

• Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make improvements.

• Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.



2. Financial Reporting & Analysis



• Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business channels.

• Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

• Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

• Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order, product category, and business segment.

• Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house production, and shipping.

• Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial results.

• Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.



3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration



We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals rather than replace them.



Responsibilities include:



• Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S. states.

• Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

• Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors when needed.

• Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

• Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related payouts.

• Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely reporting.



4. Systems, Technology & Automation



We use several software platforms, including:



• QuickBooks Online

• 

• Printavo

• InkSoft

• Chipply



Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.



We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving processes.



Responsibilities include:



• Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

• Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

• Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

• Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, we expect you to already be using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day accounting work, and to bring curiosity, strong technical aptitude, and a forward-looking approach to modern tools.



5. Payroll & Administrative Support



As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-related responsibilities.



You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:



• Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

• Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

• Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

• Employee administrative records and important milestones.

• Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.



These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.



Required Qualifications



• At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

• A stable career history, including at least 3 years in a single in-house role where you held real responsibility for a company's accounting (not freelance or multi-client bookkeeping).

• Active, hands-on use of AI tools in your current accounting work.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

• Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly closing.

• Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account reconciliations.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound accounting decisions.



Preferred, but Not Required



• Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior accountant with broad responsibilities.

• Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based businesses.

• Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

• Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

• Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

• Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.



A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-world experience are more important to us.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership and improving the way things work.



We're looking for longevity. You've held an important accounting role within one company for several years, grew with that business, and were trusted with real responsibility. If your experience is mainly freelance work or outsourced bookkeeping across many small clients, this role is likely not the right fit.



You're forward-looking. You think ahead, anticipate problems before they happen, plan for growth, and already use AI and modern tools to work smarter.



You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to improve the business.



You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice is needed, and take initiative to get things done.



We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems for the future.



We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to continuously improve.



Growth Opportunity



This position will initially report directly to the company owner.



Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can support the company as it grows.



Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and scalable finance department.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a valued, long-term member of our team.



This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity. We're looking for someone ready to commit to one company for the long term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic responses.



1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial statements?



2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?



3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial decisions?



4. Technology & Automation

Which AI tools do you use in your accounting work today, and how? Share a specific example of how AI, automation, or other technology improved an accounting process.



5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any similar experience.



6. Career Stability

What is the longest role you've held at a single company? How long were you there, what was your title, and what were you responsible for?



7. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work, improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.

title: AI-Savvy Service Delivery Specialist - Claude / ChatGPT / Codex (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover, grow and protect their Instagram and social media accounts. Customers order through our app, and every order is delivered by our team using clear step-by-step SOPs inside our own CRM.



*** THIS IS A SERVICE DELIVERY ROLE FOR SOMEONE WHO IS GENUINELY STRONG WITH AI ***

The day-to-day job is simple once you are trained: you fulfil customer orders by following our SOPs. But our whole operation runs on AI tools and our own software, so we need someone properly technical - more on the developer side than a general VA.



You must be very good with:

- Claude and ChatGPT - using BOTH every day for real work, not just for writing messages

- Claude Code, Codex or similar AI coding tools

- Picking up new software fast and following a process exactly

If AI is not already one of your strongest skills, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING

- Fulfilling service-delivery orders in our CRM and app, step by step from our SOPs

- Messaging suppliers and customers to keep each order moving

- Handling support tickets and keeping order statuses up to date

- Spotting when something (or our AI) is wrong and flagging it straight away

- Clocking in and out, and writing a short end-of-shift handover



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO WILL CHALLENGE ME

I do not want someone who just agrees with everything. If something in a process is wrong or slow, tell me and suggest a better way.



EXCELLENT ENGLISH - WRITTEN AND SPOKEN

You will write to customers and suppliers every day. Clear, natural English is a must.



THE DETAILS

- Pay: $4 USD per hour + weekly performance bonus

- Hours: minimum 8 hours a day, 6 days a week (afternoon/evening Philippine time). We are ideally looking for someone who can work up to 12 hours a day - the more hours you can reliably work, the more you earn

- Full-time, remote, long-term

- Time tracking and screen sharing during shifts

- Pay reviews at 3, 6 and 12 months



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 11 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your application with the words HUMAN CHECK so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Include how many orders, customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used. Include any technical, developer or operations experience too. If you have no support or delivery experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT A MISTAKE BY A COLLEAGUE OR DISAGREED WITH YOUR BOSS - what it was, how you noticed, what you said or did, and what happened. One short paragraph. Please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



   Hi! Good news, we are sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We will have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!



The truth at that time: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer writes: this is taking forever, I want a refund. Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact reply you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work at least 8 hours a day, 6 days a week, in the afternoon/evening Philippine time, and that you are comfortable with $4 USD per hour. Also tell us the MAXIMUM number of hours per day you can reliably work (we prefer up to 12).



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. YOUR AI SKILLS - two parts:

   a) Which AI tools and models you use (we especially want Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Codex), how often, the newest AI model or tool you have tried in the last month and what you thought of it, and the most technical thing you have done with AI (a custom GPT, an AI agent, an automation, an API integration, code you built with AI). Be specific - links or screenshots are welcome.

   b) Our AI assistant (question 4 above) keeps telling customers their order is being worked on right now and will be done today, guaranteed - when it has no way of knowing that. Write the exact instruction you would add to its system prompt to stop it, and explain in 1-2 sentences why the AI does this in the first place.



10. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



11. A 60-90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING in English (a Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar link). Unscripted: tell us about one AI tool you use every day and one thing you think most businesses get wrong about AI.



Everyone who follows all 11 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.

title: After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations)
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its asset operations division and seeking an experienced, dependable, and results-driven After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations) to oversee our overnight trucking operations.



We are looking for a hands-on operations leader who can manage fleet movements, coordinate driver dispatches, resolve operational issues, and lead a remote fleet management team (FMT). This role requires strong US trucking experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to take full ownership of night operations in a fast-paced environment.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational lead during the night shift, overseeing active trucks, drivers, trailers, and a team of approximately 5–8 remote associates. Your responsibility is to ensure every load is properly assigned, dispatched, tracked, and completed while proactively resolving breakdowns, delays, equipment issues, and service risks.



This is a hands-on leadership role, not solely a coordination or administrative position. You will be expected to make timely operational decisions, hold your team accountable, and ensure a smooth transition to the day shift.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Oversee night asset operations, monitoring truck movements, driver availability, trailer assignments, and scheduled pickups and deliveries.

• Lead and support a remote team of 5–8 associates, managing workload distribution, shift coverage, performance, and accountability.

• Coordinate driver dispatches, verify equipment assignments, conduct structured check calls, and ensure drivers receive clear instructions before scheduled movements.

• Monitor real-time fleet activity using GPS tracking systems and other operational platforms while maintaining accurate dispatch records.

• Investigate and resolve overnight operational issues, including breakdowns, roadside emergencies, route delays, equipment shortages, and missed appointments.

• Coordinate with maintenance, brokerage, and load planning teams to recover loads, arrange equipment solutions, and minimize service disruptions.

• Conduct scheduled tracking audits, maintain accurate operational reports, escalate critical risks, and prepare detailed shift handoffs.

• Identify recurring operational issues, recommend process improvements, and reinforce established SOPs across the team.



What Success Looks Like

• Maintain full visibility and operational control over active trucks, drivers, and trailers throughout the night shift.

• Ensure loads are dispatched on time, with minimal delays, missed appointments, or preventable service failures.

• Resolve operational problems proactively instead of allowing unresolved issues to carry over to the next shift.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date information across tracking systems, dispatch records, and performance reports.

• Build a reliable and accountable night team that consistently meets operational expectations.

• Deliver clear, organized shift handoffs with documented issues, actions taken, and outstanding priorities.



Who We’re Looking For

• At least 3 years of direct US trucking operations experience in dispatch, fleet management, load coordination, carrier operations, or similar roles.

• At least 1 year of team leadership or supervisory experience, including workload management, performance coaching, and accountability.

• Hands-on experience using GPS and fleet visibility platforms or comparable systems.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, driver dispatch, Hours of Service (HOS), equipment coordination, and time-sensitive freight movements.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to provide structured, concise, and actionable operational updates.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to make independent decisions under pressure.

• Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a strong ownership mindset and willingness to hold themselves and others accountable.

• Must have a reliable backup internet connection and backup power source to maintain operational continuity.

• Experience with government freight operations, fleet repair system, TMS, fuel card system, or freight recovery is an advantage. Spanish proficiency is a plus for Mexico-based applicants.



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• $75 monthly stipend (eligible after working for 30 days)

• Competitive hourly compensation based on location and experience.

• Hands-on leadership role with direct responsibility for operational performance.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Direct collaboration with US-based operations leadership.

• Opportunities to improve processes, strengthen team performance, and take on greater operational responsibilities.

• Performance recognition with growth potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire and full-time position with a US-based trucking company and permanent work-from-home setup.

• Shift: Approximately 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM US Central Time, with flexibility to extend as operationally required. 

• Workdays: Includes weekends; this is not a standard Monday–Friday schedule. To be finalized during hiring

• Active participation in Zoom for remote operational communication and collaboration is required throughout the shift.

• Time-tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power are mandatory.



If you have strong US trucking experience, know how to lead a team under pressure, and can take ownership of overnight fleet operations without waiting for instructions, we want to hear from you.

title: Project Manager and assistant
description:
Solar Project Manager & Executive Assistant



Department: Solar Operations & Sales Support

Reports To: Regional Manager / Enterprise Owner

Position Type: Full-Time

Industry: Residential Solar Energy



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Solar Project Manager & Executive Assistant to oversee our residential solar projects from the point of sale through installation, activation, and completion.



This individual will also serve as the direct assistant to the Regional Manager, helping manage daily operations, coordinate with sales representatives, communicate with homeowners, and ensure projects move efficiently through every stage.



The primary goal of this position is to keep solar projects moving, prevent unnecessary delays, support our sales team, and free up the Regional Manager to focus on recruiting, sales, leadership, and business growth.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, communicates effectively, and can manage multiple projects simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities



1. Solar Project Management



Manage all residential solar projects from signed agreement through installation and Permission to Operate (PTO).



Track every project through the solar installation pipeline.



Monitor site surveys, engineering, design approvals, permitting, installation scheduling, inspections, and utility approvals.



Coordinate with EPC partners, installers, and internal operations departments.



Identify projects experiencing delays and proactively work toward resolutions.



Follow up on missing documents, signatures, utility bills, and homeowner requirements.



Maintain accurate project statuses and estimated completion dates.



Escalate urgent project issues to the Regional Manager.



Ensure projects are progressing toward installation and activation as efficiently as possible.

Provide updates to setters and closers regarding their customers' projects.



Assist representatives with submitting complete and accurate project documentation.



Track deals submitted, approved, installed, canceled, and pending.



Follow up on outstanding project requirements that could delay installation.



Help resolve project-related issues affecting the sales team's commissions.



Coordinate with sales representatives to ensure smooth handoffs after contracts are signed.



Maintain organized records of projects associated with each representative.

Organize daily priorities and follow-up tasks.



Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and operational summaries.



Assist with internal communication between leadership, sales representatives, and operations.



Help organize sales meetings, training sessions, and team events.



Maintain organized digital files, contracts, and company records.



Follow up with individuals or departments on behalf of the Regional Manager.



Handle confidential business and team information professionally.

Maintain professional communication with homeowners throughout the solar installation process.



Provide project updates and explain next steps when necessary.



Follow up with homeowners regarding scheduling, documents, and project requirements.



Help resolve customer concerns by coordinating with the appropriate departments.



Ensure homeowners receive timely updates when project milestones change.



Assist in preventing cancellations caused by poor communication or unnecessary delays.



Escalate contractual, technical, or financing concerns to authorized personnel.



5. CRM & Project Tracking



Maintain accurate and updated information in the company's CRM and solar project management platforms.



Create and maintain a master project tracking spreadsheet.



Track important project information, including:



Customer name and project identification number



Setter and closer assigned



Date of sale



System size and equipment



Finance or PPA provider



Project status



Site survey and permitting status



Installation date



PTO status



Commission status



Ensure information is updated consistently and accurately.



Identify stalled projects and prioritize follow-ups.



6. Commission & Installation Tracking



Monitor completed installations and project milestones relevant to commission eligibility.



Maintain accurate installation records for each sales representative.



Coordinate with accounting or commission departments regarding outstanding payments.



Track pending commissions, payment statuses, and discrepancies.



Notify the Regional Manager of projects with commission issues.



Prepare weekly installation and commission tracking reports.



This position tracks and reconciles commission information but does not independently authorize payments.



Daily Responsibilities



Each workday, the Project Manager & Executive Assistant will:



Review all active solar projects and identify urgent issues.



Follow up with EPC partners and operations teams on delayed projects.



Update the master project tracker and CRM.



Communicate important project updates to sales representatives.



Contact homeowners when documentation or scheduling is required.

Assist the Regional Manager with meetings, schedules, and administrative priorities.

Review outstanding documentation and permitting issues.

Qualifications

Excellent written and verbal communication.



Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

ABOUT TÀBERG FALLS



Tàberg Falls Private Villas is a luxury resort of glass villas for couples, located on a river with a waterfall in Taberg, New York, at the gateway to the Adirondacks.



We opened in summer 2026, book direct with our guests, and have grown our Instagram audience to approximately 28,000 followers.



We are growing our marketing team and looking for an experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to own strategy and execution.



We are looking for a marketer, not simply someone who posts on social media.



The right person may eventually have the opportunity to build and lead a small marketing and content team as Tàberg Falls expands.





THE CREATIVE DIRECTION



Tàberg Falls is visually beautiful, but we do not want our social media to feel like a catalog of property photos.



We want to increasingly show real couples genuinely experiencing Tàberg Falls in a way that feels romantic, natural, believable, and human.



We want content that helps people imagine what it would feel like to stay here with someone they love.



Beautiful photography and editing matter, but the finished content should not feel artificial, overly produced, or AI-generated.



Real people, real moments, and real experiences should be at the center of the brand.



Authenticity is one of the core principles of the marketing we are building. We want people to trust what they see and feel that the experience we are showing is real.



We are looking for someone who can bring their own creativity and point of view to that direction while protecting the authenticity and trust we want the brand to communicate.





WHO WE’RE MARKETING TO



Our primary audience is established couples ages 30–60, primarily from greater NYC, Connecticut, Northern New Jersey, Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, Utica, and surrounding markets.



They are often busy professionals or business owners looking to disconnect from demanding lives and reconnect with each other.



Our goal is qualified audience growth that leads to direct bookings. Our broader marketing objective is to help drive Tàberg Falls toward 80%+ occupancy while maintaining or improving ADR.





WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Build and maintain a content calendar at least one month ahead

- Post approximately 3–5 times per week on Instagram and

- Turn raw footage into Reels, Stories, carousels, posts, and ads

- Develop hooks, captions, campaign ideas, and calls to action

- Study performance and adjust strategy based on results

- Help direct what footage our team and creators should capture

- Create clean, photo-led carousels and graphics

- Monitor comments and messages and coordinate with our guest communication team



Leadership will initially provide final approval, but we expect you to own the work leading up to it.





META ADVERTISING

Responsibilities may include building and managing Meta campaigns, testing creative and audiences, monitoring performance, developing retargeting campaigns, improving conversion tracking, and keeping the focus on direct bookings and measurable return.



Experience with Meta Pixel, retargeting, and conversion tracking is a strong advantage.





CREATOR & MEDIA MANAGEMENT



You will help vet and recommend creators, coordinate stays, provide creative direction, collect raw footage, and identify creators worth working with again. Leadership gives final approval on partnerships.



You will also own our Google Drive media library. Our team should be able to upload raw, unorganized footage without sorting it first. You will review it, identify the strongest usable content, prepare B-roll, preserve originals, and keep everything organized and searchable.





COPYWRITING,
 & WEBSITE SKILLS

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Strong short-form video editing

- Strong understanding of Instagram and

- Excellent written English

- Strong creative judgment, organization, and attention to detail

- Meta Pixel, retargeting, or conversion-tracking experience

Hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, tourism, or consumer-brand experience is a plus.





SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

WATERFALL

 or website examples, if available.

If you became responsible for our marketing tomorrow, what is one thing you would improve during your first 30 days, and why?

Notes from Post is a growing education company that teaches independent filmmakers about post-production. We're looking for a talented, reliable video editor to join our small team and grow with us. This role will evolve over time, and we'd love to find someone for the long term.



What you'll be editing:



Long-form YouTube videos: educational and story-driven videos for filmmakers. You'll shape pacing, add b-roll, graphics, music, and sound design, and help make every minute worth watching.

Short-form videos for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts: fast, engaging clips with strong hooks, captions, and a consistent brand style. Some will be cut from long-form videos, and some will be filmed on their own.

Teaching videos for our Skool community: clear, polished lessons that may include screen recordings of editing software, zoom-ins and callouts, on-screen text, and chapter titles. Clarity matters most here, so students can follow along easily.



How you'll work with us:



Our founder records all of her own videos, and you'll receive the raw footage along with notes on what each piece needs. You'll also work alongside our social media VA, who manages the posting calendar, so meeting deadlines and communicating clearly about your progress are very important.



Our founder is a professional editor herself with experience on major network and streaming projects, so you'll get detailed, specific feedback. We're looking for someone who welcomes notes and sees them as a chance to grow.



What we're looking for:



-Proven experience editing YouTube videos and short-form content

-Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

-A great sense of pacing, rhythm, and storytelling

-Experience with captions, motion text, and basic graphics

-Experience editing tutorials, courses, or screen recordings is a big plus

-Good English communication skills

-A reliable computer and internet connection that can handle large video files

-A creative thinker who brings ideas to the table, such as hooks, edit styles, and trends worth trying



Nice to have:



-Thumbnail design

-Color correction and audio cleanup

-Motion graphics (After Effects or similar)

-Familiarity with the filmmaking or education niche



What we offer:



-Flexible scheduling: work during your normal business hours

-A weekly check-in to plan the week's edits (we're based in the US, but you'll very rarely need to be available outside your regular hours)

-Long-term work with a growing company

-Feedback and mentorship from an experienced professional editor



How to apply:



It's very important to us that you have positive feedback from previous clients. If possible, please include references from employers in English-speaking countries.



Please include links to your best work, ideally at least one long-form video and a few short-form edits. If you've edited any tutorials or course videos, please share those too.



Finalists will complete a short paid test edit.



Somewhere in your cover letter or application, use the word "popcorn" (without quotes).



To apply, fill out our application form at: forms [·] gle / q 6 Z Y 4 B m T 2 W Q U V 3 b h 9



Wage/Salary: Negotiable

title: eClinical Works onboarding specialists Experience Required
description:
Job Posting: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding & Training Specialist



Position Title: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist

Department: Healthcare Operations / Clinical Information Systems

Employment Type: Full-Time Remote with offsite support.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist to support the implementation, configuration, onboarding, and ongoing training of clinical and administrative personnel across a growing network of physician practices and outpatient healthcare facilities.



The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience with the eClinicalWorks Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Practice Management (PM) platforms, including provider onboarding, clinical workflow development, staff training, system optimization, and troubleshooting.



This position requires an individual who can independently manage onboarding activities, train physicians and staff, identify workflow inefficiencies, and ensure consistent and effective utilization of eClinicalWorks across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Provider and Staff Onboarding



* Coordinate and manage eClinicalWorks onboarding for newly hired physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, medical assistants, and administrative staff.

* Configure user accounts, role-based permissions, provider profiles, and appropriate system access in coordination with authorized system administrators.

* Assist with provider scheduling templates, appointment types, clinical documentation templates, and practice-specific workflows.

* Ensure new employees receive appropriate training before independently using the EHR.

* Develop standardized onboarding checklists and training completion requirements.

* Support onboarding of newly acquired or established practices transitioning to eClinicalWorks.



2. eClinicalWorks Training and Education



* Conduct individual and group training sessions for physicians, clinical staff, and administrative personnel.

* Provide comprehensive instruction on eClinicalWorks functionality, including:

    * Patient registration and demographics

    * Appointment scheduling and provider calendars

    * Clinical documentation and progress notes

    * Electronic prescribing (eRx)

    * Medication reconciliation

    * Laboratory and diagnostic imaging orders

    * Referral management

    * Clinical templates and order sets

    * Patient portal and communication workflows

    * Billing, charge capture, and practice management

    * Task management, telephone encounters, and clinical messaging

* Develop training manuals, quick-reference guides, instructional videos, and competency assessments.

* Provide refresher training following software updates, workflow changes, or identified performance deficiencies.



3. Workflow Development and Optimization



* Evaluate existing clinical and administrative workflows to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

* Collaborate with physicians, clinical leadership, and operations teams to standardize workflows across multiple practice locations.

* Assist in developing and optimizing documentation templates, clinical protocols, order sets, and specialty-specific workflows.

* Support improvements in documentation accuracy, charge capture, and revenue cycle processes.

* Recommend system configuration changes to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* Ensure eClinicalWorks workflows support regulatory requirements and organizational policies.



4. Implementation and System Support



* Participate in new practice implementations, EHR deployments, and system upgrades.

* Assist with practice setup, testing, workflow validation, and go-live readiness.

* Provide hands-on support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

* Troubleshoot common user issues involving documentation, scheduling, prescriptions, orders, and other EHR functions.

* Escalate technical problems to eClinicalWorks support or internal IT personnel when appropriate.

* Track reported issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.

* Maintain standardized system configuration and training documentation.



5. Compliance and Quality Assurance



* Train personnel on accurate clinical documentation and proper use of electronic health records.

* Promote compliance with HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and organizational information security requirements.

* Support appropriate documentation, coding, and billing workflows.

* Monitor completion of required onboarding and system competency assessments.

* Identify recurring user errors and implement corrective education.

* Collaborate with clinical leadership to support documentation quality and operational performance.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks, preferably in implementation, onboarding, training, or EHR administration.

* Demonstrated experience training physicians, clinical staff, and administrative teams.

* Strong understanding of eClinicalWorks EHR and Practice Management functionality.

* Experience configuring clinical workflows, scheduling templates, provider profiles, and user permissions.

* Knowledge of medical office operations, patient registration, clinical documentation, and billing workflows.

* Ability to troubleshoot application-related issues and communicate effectively with technical support teams.

* Strong organizational, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and onboarding schedules simultaneously.

* Proficiency in developing training materials, standard operating procedures, and competency assessments.

* Ability to work independently in a remote or multisite healthcare environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience as an eClinicalWorks Trainer, Implementation Specialist, Application Specialist, or EHR Administrator.

* Formal eClinicalWorks training or certification, if available and applicable.

* Experience supporting multiple medical practices or multispecialty healthcare organizations.

* Familiarity with specialty-specific clinical workflows, including orthopedics, pain management, spine, physical medicine, and outpatient surgery.

* Experience with eClinicalWorks reporting, population health tools, and operational dashboards.

* Knowledge of revenue cycle management, charge capture, and claims workflows.

* Experience supporting EHR conversions, practice acquisitions, or multisite implementations.

* Clinical background as a Registered Nurse, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Medical Assistant, or other healthcare professional is beneficial but not required.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be expected to:



1. Independently coordinate and complete provider and employee EHR onboarding.

2. Deliver effective training that prepares employees to perform assigned responsibilities within eClinicalWorks.

3. Maintain accurate training records and onboarding documentation.

4. Reduce recurring system-related errors through targeted education.

5. Support consistent EHR workflows across all assigned locations.

6. Respond promptly to training requests and application support issues.

7. Identify opportunities to improve provider productivity, clinical documentation, and operational efficiency.

8. Provide regular progress reports regarding onboarding completion, training activities, and outstanding issues.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for a hands-on eClinicalWorks expert, not simply an individual who has used the software in a clinical or administrative role.



The successful candidate must understand how eClinicalWorks is configured, how physicians and staff use the platform, and how to train personnel to use the system accurately and efficiently.



This role requires exceptional troubleshooting skills, independent problem-solving, and the ability to translate complex EHR functions into clear, practical instructions for healthcare professionals.



Application Requirements



Applicants should submit a current resume highlighting their direct eClinicalWorks experience, including:



* Number of years working with eClinicalWorks.

* Specific eClinicalWorks modules and functionality supported.

* Experience onboarding providers and clinical staff.

* Experience developing and delivering EHR training.

* Number and types of medical practices supported.

* Experience with implementation, system configuration, and workflow optimization.

* Availability, preferred work arrangement, and compensation expectations.



Important: Direct, hands-on eClinicalWorks experience is required. General EHR experience with Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, or other platforms alone will not satisfy this requirement.

title: Outreach & Partnerships Specialist (B2B Follow-Up + Creator Partnerships)
description:
About us

We're a small, founder-led e-commerce studio running two US-focused DTC brands:

A personalized book brand. Our newest product is a B2B gifting program: companies send their prospects a real, printed book written about that person, then follow up once it lands. It's the most memorable first touch a prospect will ever get.

A health tech brand making simple health smartwatches for adults 65+ and the families who look out for them.

Lean team, real ownership, fast decisions. You'll report to our marketing and operations lead and work directly with the founder.

The role

About 80% of your time covers three areas. The other 20% goes to whatever marketing work matters most that week: research, launch support, and testing new channels.

1. B2B follow-up (top priority)

We mail personalized books to targeted decision makers at US companies, mostly marketing, sales, and HR leaders.

Once a book is delivered, you call,
, and message the recipient on LinkedIn to turn their surprise into a booked demo.

You research prospects before reaching out and log every touch.

As you ramp up, you'll run some intro calls yourself.

If we test B2B for the smartwatch brand, you'll also reach out to organizations that serve older adults.

2. Creator partnerships

Find and vet creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube:

Parenting and family creators for the book brand

Aging, caregiving, and retirement creators (including "adult children of aging parents") for the smartwatch brand

Pitch collaborations, agree on deliverables, coordinate product seeding, keep content on schedule, and keep good relationships warm.

3.
 marketing

Help write, build, and send campaigns and simple automated flows (we use Klaviyo).

What success looks like

Every delivered book is followed up within a day.

Demos are booked every week.

A steady stream of creator content goes live.

The pipeline is clean enough that anyone can see where every lead stands.

We'll set specific targets together in your first month.

What you bring

2+ years in B2B outbound (SDR/BDR), partnerships, or influencer marketing

Real experience cold calling US businesses (outbound, not only inbound support)

Excellent spoken English: natural and confident with senior US professionals

Strong written English for
s, LinkedIn messages, and DMs

Persistence across multiple touches, and resilience with "no"

Experience vetting creators, including spotting fake followers and weak engagement

Discipline with a CRM or tracker (we use Airtable)

Comfort with priorities that shift week to week

Bonus points

Apollo, Klaviyo, or similar tools

Experience selling to marketing, sales, or HR leaders

Familiarity with corporate gifting or direct mail outreach

Details

Long-term contract, about 40 hours per week

Remote

You must work US Pacific business hours, because calls happen when US prospects are at their desks. That means a fixed shift of 12 am to 8 am Manila time.
